#PART A.Phenotype Data and trentd analysis

#plot for FQ-R Salmonella Enteritidis in Chicken and Human Sources 

# remove 2025 and also 95% C.I
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

data <- read_csv(
  "FDASEN_AMRPhenotype2.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

trend <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(Year),

    Source = factor(
      as.character(Source),
      levels = c("Human", "Chicken")
    ),

    Cip_Resistant = as.numeric(Cip_Resistant),
    Cip_Tested    = as.numeric(Cip_Tested),

    DSC_Resistant = as.numeric(DSC_Resistant),
    DSC_Tested    = as.numeric(DSC_Tested)
  ) %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(Year),
    !Year %in% c(2024, 2025)
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    Tested = pmax(
      Cip_Tested,
      DSC_Tested,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # =====================================================
    # PHENOTYPE PERCENTAGES
    # =====================================================

    CipR_pct = if_else(
      Tested > 0,
      100 * Cip_Resistant / Tested,
      NA_real_
    ),

    DSC_pct = if_else(
      Tested > 0,
      100 * DSC_Resistant / Tested,
      NA_real_
    ),

    # Internal name = QRFQR
    # Displayed name later = QR/FQR
    QRFQR_pct = if_else(
      Tested > 0,
      100 * (Cip_Resistant + DSC_Resistant) / Tested,
      NA_real_
    ),


    # =====================================================
    # 95% CI — NORMAL APPROXIMATION
    # =====================================================

    CipR_se = if_else(
      Tested > 0,
      100 * sqrt(
        (Cip_Resistant / Tested) *
          (1 - (Cip_Resistant / Tested)) /
          Tested
      ),
      NA_real_
    ),

    DSC_se = if_else(
      Tested > 0,
      100 * sqrt(
        (DSC_Resistant / Tested) *
          (1 - (DSC_Resistant / Tested)) /
          Tested
      ),
      NA_real_
    ),

    QRFQR_se = if_else(
      Tested > 0,
      100 * sqrt(
        (
          ((Cip_Resistant + DSC_Resistant) / Tested) *
            (1 - ((Cip_Resistant + DSC_Resistant) / Tested)) /
            Tested
        )
      ),
      NA_real_
    ),


    # =====================================================
    # CONFIDENCE LIMITS
    # =====================================================

    CipR_lo = CipR_pct - 1.96 * CipR_se,
    CipR_hi = CipR_pct + 1.96 * CipR_se,

    DSC_lo = DSC_pct - 1.96 * DSC_se,
    DSC_hi = DSC_pct + 1.96 * DSC_se,

    QRFQR_lo = QRFQR_pct - 1.96 * QRFQR_se,
    QRFQR_hi = QRFQR_pct + 1.96 * QRFQR_se
  ) %>%

  select(
    Year,
    Source,

    QRFQR_pct,
    QRFQR_lo,
    QRFQR_hi,

    DSC_pct,
    DSC_lo,
    DSC_hi,

    CipR_pct,
    CipR_lo,
    CipR_hi
  ) %>%

  # =======================================================
  # LONG FORMAT
  #
  # QRFQR is used internally because "/" in variable names
  # would complicate parsing.
  # =======================================================

  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Year, Source),

    names_to = c(
      "Metric",
      ".value"
    ),

    names_pattern =
      "^(QRFQR|DSC|CipR)_(pct|lo|hi)$"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    # =====================================================
    # DISPLAY LABELS
    # =====================================================

    Metric = recode(
      Metric,

      QRFQR = "Nal-R/DSC or Cip-R",

      DSC = "Nal-R/DSC",

      CipR = "Cip-R"
    ),

    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c(
        "Nal-R/DSC or Cip-R",
        "Nal-R/DSC",
        "Cip-R"
      )
    ),

    lo = pmax(
      lo,
      0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    Source,
    Metric
  ) %>%

  complete(
    Year = full_seq(Year, 1)
  ) %>%

  ungroup()


# =========================================================
# SHAPES
# =========================================================

shape_map <- c(
  "Nal-R/DSC or Cip-R" = 16,
  "Nal-R/DSC"                   = 15,
  "Cip-R"                       = 17
)


# =========================================================
# PLOT
# =========================================================

p <- ggplot(
  trend,
  aes(
    x = Year,
    y = pct,
    color = Source,
    linetype = Metric
  )
) +

  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = lo,
      ymax = hi,
      fill = Source
    ),
    alpha = 0.15,
    color = NA,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.9,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Metric
    ),
    size = 2.0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_shape_manual(
    values = shape_map
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Human" = "red",
      "Chicken" = "blue"
    )
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Human" = "red",
      "Chicken" = "blue"
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(12)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),

    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0.05
      )
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Year of Isolation",
    y = "Percentage (%)",

    color = "Source",
    fill = "Source",

    linetype = "Phenotype",
    shape = "Phenotype"

    # title = "Quinolone/fluoroquinolone resistance trends (Human vs Chicken) with 95% CI"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 11,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 8
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),

    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),

    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),

    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.25
    ),

    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.25
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# PRINT
# =========================================================

print(p)


# =========================================================
# SAVE
# =========================================================

ggsave(
  "FQ_trends_Human_vs_Chicken.png",
  p,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.8,
  dpi = 1200
)

ggsave(
  "FQ_trends_Human_vs_Chicken.pdf",
  p,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.8
)

ggsave(
  "FQ_trends_Human_vs_Chicken.tif",
  p,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.8
)

```


#PArtB. Genotpe data and trend analysis and genome selection

#1. load the Datasets 
```{r}
# ================================
# READ FILE (choose ONE)
# ================================

# ---- A) If it's REALLY a CSV ----
file_path <- "US-SEN_12192025.csv"
SEN <- read_csv(file_path, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
```

#2. Filter all quinolone/fluoroquinole-resistance marker 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

amr_col <- "AMR genotypes"

# Broad QR marker regex (genes + QRDR mutations + PMQR + efflux/regulators)
pattern_fqr_all <- paste0(
  "(^|,)(",
  # QRDR mutations
  "gyr[a-b]_[^,=]+|par[c-e]_[^,=]+|",
  # PMQR genes
  "qnr[a-z0-9._-]*|aac\\(6'\\)-ib-cr|qep[a-z0-9._-]*|oqx[a-b]|",
  # additional PMQR / emerging markers
  "qnrvc[a-z0-9._-]*|crpP|",
  # efflux & regulators often annotated as POINT
  "acr[a-b]_[^,=]+|tolc_[^,=]+|ram[ar]_[^,=]+|mar[ar]_[^,=]+|sox[rs]_[^,=]+",
  ")(?==)"
)

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    amr_txt = str_to_lower(as.character(.data[[amr_col]])),
    amr_txt = if_else(is.na(amr_txt), "", amr_txt),
    FQR_genotype = if_else(
      str_detect(amr_txt, regex(pattern_fqr_all, ignore_case = TRUE)),
      1L, 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-amr_txt)


SEN %>%
  count(FQR_genotype)



```
#3. Frequency of all (Top100) FQR markers 
```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

# =========================
# CONFIG
# =========================
amr_col <- "AMR genotypes"
id_col  <- "Isolate"   # CHANGE if needed

# =========================
# Pretty display casing for FQR markers (comprehensive for your list)
# - gene family corrected (gyrA, qnrB, etc.)
# - mutation part uppercased (e.g., gyrA_d87g -> gyrA_D87G)
# - keeps underscore format: gyrA_D87G, qnrB19, qnrVC1
# =========================
pretty_token <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_trim(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "\\s+", "")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "-", "_")

  # replace only at start, keep remainder (e.g., qnrb19 -> qnrB19; gyra_d87g -> gyrA_d87g)
  fix_start <- function(s, from, to) {
    str_replace(s, paste0("^", from), to)
  }

  # chromosomal targets
  x <- fix_start(x, "gyra", "gyrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "gyrb", "gyrB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "parc", "parC")
  x <- fix_start(x, "pare", "parE")
  x <- fix_start(x, "pard", "parD")
  x <- fix_start(x, "grla", "grlA")

  # PMQR: qnr family
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnras", "qnrAS")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnra",  "qnrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrb",  "qnrB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrc",  "qnrC")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrd",  "qnrD")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnre",  "qnrE")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrs",  "qnrS")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrvc", "qnrVC")

  # qepA (and qep variants)
  x <- fix_start(x, "qepa", "qepA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qep",  "qep")

  # other families you listed / QR-linked
  x <- fix_start(x, "nfxb", "nfxB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "emrr", "emrR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "norm", "norM")
  x <- fix_start(x, "pmra", "pmrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "acrb", "acrB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "smef", "smeF")

  # prior extras
  x <- fix_start(x, "acra", "acrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "tolc", "tolC")
  x <- fix_start(x, "crpp", "crpP")
  x <- fix_start(x, "oqxa", "oqxA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "oqxb", "oqxB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "rama", "ramA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "ramr", "ramR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "mara", "marA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "marr", "marR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "soxr", "soxR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "soxs", "soxS")

  # exact enzyme token (keep exact casing)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "^aac\\(6'\\)-ib-cr", "aac(6')-Ib-cr")

  # uppercase mutation / suffix after first underscore if present: gyrA_d87g -> gyrA_D87G
  parts <- str_split_fixed(x, "_", 2)
  gene_part <- parts[, 1]
  rest_part <- parts[, 2]
  rest_part <- ifelse(rest_part == "", rest_part, toupper(rest_part))
  x <- ifelse(rest_part == "", gene_part, paste0(gene_part, "_", rest_part))

  x
}

# =========================
# FQR marker regex (includes your 20 gene families + prior QR markers)
# =========================
fqr_regex <- regex(
  paste0(
    "^(",
    "(gyr[a-b](?:_.+)?|par[c-e](?:_.+)?|grla(?:_.+)?)(?:$)|",
    "(qnr(as|[a-z0-9._-]*))(?:$)|",
    "(qnrvc[a-z0-9._-]*)(?:$)|",
    "(qep[a-z0-9._-]*)(?:$)|",
    "(nfxb(?:_.+)?|emrr(?:_.+)?|norm(?:_.+)?|pmra(?:_.+)?|acrb(?:_.+)?|smef(?:_.+)?)(?:$)|",
    "(aac\\(6'\\)-ib-cr(?:_.+)?|oqx[a-b](?:_.+)?|crpp(?:_.+)?|acr[a-b](?:_.+)?|tolc(?:_.+)?|ram[ar](?:_.+)?|mar[ar](?:_.+)?|sox[rs](?:_.+)?)(?:$)",
    ")"
  ),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

# =========================
# 1) Tokenize AMR genotypes
# =========================
SEN_tok <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    isolate_id = as.character(.data[[id_col]]),
    amr_txt = as.character(.data[[amr_col]]),
    amr_txt = if_else(is.na(amr_txt), "", amr_txt),
    token = str_extract_all(amr_txt, "[^,=\\s]+(?==)")
  ) %>%
  select(isolate_id, token) %>%
  unnest_longer(token) %>%
  mutate(
    token = str_trim(token),
    token = str_replace_all(token, "\\s+", "")
  )

# =========================
# 2) Keep only FQR-related markers
# =========================
SEN_fqr_tokens <- SEN_tok %>%
  filter(str_detect(token, fqr_regex)) %>%
  mutate(
    token_norm   = str_to_lower(token),
    token_pretty = pretty_token(token_norm)
  )

# =========================
# 3) TABLE: frequency, percent, 95% CI per marker + susceptible
#    Denominator = number of UNIQUE isolates in SEN
# =========================
all_isolates <- SEN %>%
  transmute(isolate_id = as.character(.data[[id_col]])) %>%
  distinct()

N_isolates <- nrow(all_isolates)

isolates_any_marker <- SEN_fqr_tokens %>%
  distinct(isolate_id)

n_any  <- nrow(isolates_any_marker)
n_susc <- N_isolates - n_any

marker_table <- SEN_fqr_tokens %>%
  distinct(isolate_id, token_pretty) %>%
  count(token_pretty, name = "n_isolates") %>%
  mutate(
    Type = "QR/FQR marker",
    N = N_isolates,
    p = n_isolates / N,
    pct = 100 * p,
    se = sqrt(p * (1 - p) / N),
    lo = pmax(0, 100 * (p - 1.96 * se)),
    hi = pmin(100, 100 * (p + 1.96 * se))
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      token_pretty = "Q/FQ-susceptible",
      n_isolates = n_susc,
      Type = "Q/FQ-susceptible",
      N = N_isolates,
      p = n_susc / N_isolates,
      pct = 100 * (n_susc / N_isolates),
      se = sqrt((n_susc / N_isolates) * (1 - (n_susc / N_isolates)) / N_isolates),
      lo = pmax(0, 100 * ((n_susc / N_isolates) - 1.96 * sqrt((n_susc / N_isolates) * (1 - (n_susc / N_isolates)) / N_isolates))),
      hi = pmin(100, 100 * ((n_susc / N_isolates) + 1.96 * sqrt((n_susc / N_isolates) * (1 - (n_susc / N_isolates)) / N_isolates)))
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_isolates))

print(marker_table, n = Inf)

write_csv(
  marker_table %>% select(token_pretty, Type, n_isolates, N, pct, lo, hi),
  "FQR_marker_frequency_percentage_95CI_with_susceptible.csv"
)

# =========================
# 4) Plot: top 100 markers with count + (percent) labels
#    - percent shown to 3 decimal places
#    - if percent < 0.01% show "<0.01%"
#    Susceptible bar is BLUE; all other bars are PINK3 (as you had)
# =========================
plot_df <- marker_table %>%
  slice_head(n = 100) %>%
  mutate(
    token_pretty = factor(token_pretty, levels = rev(token_pretty)),
    pct_label_plot = if_else(pct < 0.01, "<0.01%", sprintf("%.3f%%", pct)),
    label_plot = paste0(n_isolates, " (", pct_label_plot, ")")
  )

p_tokens <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = token_pretty, y = n_isolates, fill = Type)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label_plot), hjust = -0.1, size =3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Q/FQ-susceptible" = "green4", "QR/FQR marker" = "red3")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 22000),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(x = "QR/FQR Markers", y = "Genomes(n (%))") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_tokens)

ggsave("FQR_marker_counts_top100.png", p_tokens, width = 7.5, height = 10, dpi = 600)
ggsave("FQR_marker_counts_top100.tif", p_tokens, width = 7.5, height = 10, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
ggsave("FQR_marker_counts_top100.pdf", p_tokens, width = 7.5, height = 10)

# =========================
# 5) Per-isolate marker counts + print counts/percentages
# =========================
iso_marker_list <- SEN_fqr_tokens %>%
  distinct(isolate_id, token_norm, token_pretty) %>%
  group_by(isolate_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_markers = n(),
    markers = paste(sort(unique(token_pretty)), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

marker_bins <- iso_marker_list %>%
  mutate(bin = case_when(
    n_markers == 1 ~ "1 marker",
    n_markers == 2 ~ "2 markers",
    n_markers >  2 ~ ">2 markers",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bin)) %>%
  count(bin, name = "n_isolates") %>%
  mutate(
    pct_isolates = 100 * n_isolates / sum(n_isolates),
    bin = factor(bin, levels = c("1 marker", "2 markers", ">2 markers"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(bin)

print(marker_bins, n = Inf)

cat("\nMarker burden summary (FQR markers only):\n")
marker_bins %>%
  mutate(line = sprintf("%s: %d isolates (%.1f%%)", bin, n_isolates, pct_isolates)) %>%
  pull(line) %>%
  cat(sep = "\n")
cat("\n")

# =========================
# 6) Table + CSV of isolates with >1 marker (and their markers)
# =========================
iso_gt1 <- iso_marker_list %>%
  filter(n_markers > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_markers), isolate_id)

print(iso_gt1, n = Inf)
write_csv(iso_gt1, "isolates_more_than_one_FQR_marker.csv")

# =========================
# 7) Plot: marker-burden bins + save
#    STRICTLY red3
# =========================
p_bins <- ggplot(marker_bins, aes(x = bin, y = n_isolates)) +
  geom_col(fill = "red3") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%d (%.2f%%)", n_isolates, pct_isolates)),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "QR/FQR marker per genome (n)",
    y = "Genomes (n)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_bins)

ggsave(
  "FQR_marker_burden_bins.png",
  p_bins,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 4.2,
  dpi = 600
)

ggsave(
  "FQR_marker_burden_bins.tif",
  p_bins,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 4.2,
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw"
)

ggsave(
  "FQR_marker_burden_bins.pdf",
  p_bins,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 4.2
)


# ============================================================
# 8) EXACTLY 2 QR/FQR MARKERS:
#    Unique marker-combination counts
# ============================================================

combo_2 <- iso_marker_list %>%
  filter(n_markers == 2) %>%
  count(markers, name = "n_isolates") %>%
  mutate(
    pct = 100 * n_isolates / sum(n_isolates),
    pct_label = sprintf("%.2f%%", pct),
    label_plot = paste0(n_isolates, " (", pct_label, ")")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_isolates), markers)

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("Unique combinations of exactly 2 QR/FQR markers\n")
cat("============================================\n")

print(combo_2, n = Inf)

write_csv(
  combo_2,
  "FQR_exactly_2_marker_combinations.csv"
)


# Order combinations by frequency
combo_2_plot <- combo_2 %>%
  mutate(
    markers = factor(
      markers,
      levels = rev(markers)
    )
  )


# Dynamic plot height so labels remain readable
height_2 <- max(
  5,
  0.28 * nrow(combo_2_plot) + 1.5
)


p_combo_2 <- ggplot(
  combo_2_plot,
  aes(x = markers, y = n_isolates)
) +
  geom_col(fill = "red3") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label_plot),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Combination of 2 QR/FQR markers",
    y = "Genomes (n)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 8,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),
```

#4. Downsize the QR-markers to focus on most important
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

amr_col <- "AMR genotypes"

# =========================
# 1) TOKENIZE + keep ALL QR tokens (original chart data)
# =========================
SEN_tok <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    amr_txt = as.character(.data[[amr_col]]),
    amr_txt = if_else(is.na(amr_txt), "", amr_txt),
    token = str_extract_all(amr_txt, "[^,=\\s]+(?==)")
  ) %>%
  select(token) %>%
  unnest_longer(token) %>%
  mutate(
    token = str_trim(token),
    token = str_replace_all(token, "\\s+", "")
  )

SEN_qr_tokens <- SEN_tok %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      token,
      regex(
        "^(gyr[a-b]_.+|par[c-e]_.+|qnr[a-z0-9._-]*|qnrvc[a-z0-9._-]*|aac\\(6'\\)-ib-cr|qep[a-z0-9._-]*|oqx[a-b]|crpP|acr[a-b]_.+|tolc_.+|ram[ar]_.+|mar[ar]_.+|sox[rs]_.+)$",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(token_norm = str_to_lower(token))

# =========================
# 2) ORIGINAL CHART (top 100 unique tokens)
# =========================
qr_token_counts <- SEN_qr_tokens %>%
  count(token_norm, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100) %>%
  mutate(token_norm = factor(token_norm, levels = rev(token_norm)))

p_original <- ggplot(qr_token_counts, aes(x = token_norm, y = n, fill = token_norm)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 15000), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = "Unique QR marker", y = "Count") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_original)

# =========================
# 3) NEW CHART:
#    keep top 5 gyrA tokens as-is, group the rest into families:
#    gyrA_others, qnr_all, gyrB_all, parC_all, parD_all, parE_all, etc.
# =========================

# top 5 gyrA tokens (by count)
top5_gyrA <- SEN_qr_tokens %>%
  filter(str_detect(token_norm, "^gyra_")) %>%
  count(token_norm, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(token_norm)

# relabel into grouped buckets
SEN_qr_grouped <- SEN_qr_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    marker_group = case_when(
      token_norm %in% top5_gyrA ~ token_norm,

      str_detect(token_norm, "^gyra_") ~ "gyra_others",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^gyrb_") ~ "gyrb_all",

      str_detect(token_norm, "^parc_") ~ "parc_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^pard_") ~ "pard_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^pare_") ~ "pare_all",

      str_detect(token_norm, "^qnrvc") ~ "qnrvc_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^qnr")   ~ "qnr_all",

      token_norm == "aac(6')-ib-cr"    ~ "aac(6')-ib-cr",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^qep")   ~ "qep_all",
      token_norm == "oqxa"             ~ "oqxa",
      token_norm == "oqxb"             ~ "oqxb",
      token_norm == "crpp"             ~ "crpp",

      str_detect(token_norm, "^acra_") ~ "acra_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^acrb_") ~ "acrb_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^tolc_") ~ "tolc_all",

      str_detect(token_norm, "^rama_") ~ "rama_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^ramr_") ~ "ramr_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^mara_") ~ "mara_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^marr_") ~ "marr_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^soxr_") ~ "soxr_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^soxs_") ~ "soxs_all",

      TRUE ~ "other_qr"
    )
  )

qr_group_counts <- SEN_qr_grouped %>%
  count(marker_group, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(marker_group = factor(marker_group, levels = rev(marker_group)))

p_grouped <- ggplot(qr_group_counts, aes(x = marker_group, y = n, fill = marker_group)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 15000), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = "QR marker (top 5 gyrA kept, others grouped)", y = "Count") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_grouped)



```
#5. A. Yearly distribute of all SEN sequenced isolates B. Yearly distribution stacked into QR and non-QR
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# ============================================================
# 1) ROBUSTLY EXTRACT COLLECTION YEAR
# ============================================================

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    Collection_date_raw = as.character(`Collection date`),

    Collection_date_clean = Collection_date_raw %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_replace_all("_", "-") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\.", "/") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>%
      str_replace_all(
        "(?i)^(na|n/a|none|unknown|unk|\\.)$",
        NA_character_
      ),

    Collection_date_parsed = suppressWarnings(
      parse_date_time(
        Collection_date_clean,
        orders = c(
          "Ymd", "Y-m-d", "Y/m/d",
          "mdY", "m/d/Y", "m-d-Y", "m.d.Y",
          "dmY", "d/m/Y", "d-m-Y", "d.m.Y",
          "b d Y", "d b Y", "B d Y", "d B Y",
          "Y b d", "Y B d",
          "b Y", "B Y",
          "Y b", "Y B",
          "Y"
        ),
        tz = "UTC",
        exact = FALSE
      )
    ),

    Collection_year = year(Collection_date_parsed),

    # Fallback to any plausible four-digit year
    Collection_year = if_else(
      is.na(Collection_year),
      suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          str_extract(
            Collection_date_clean,
            "(19|20)\\d{2}"
          )
        )
      ),
      Collection_year
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 2) QUICK CHECK OF COLLECTION YEARS
# ============================================================

SEN %>%
  count(Collection_year, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print(n = Inf)


# ============================================================
# 3) DERIVE QR/FQR STATUS FROM YOUR EXISTING MARKER TABLE
# ============================================================
# SEN_fqr_tokens was created in your previous QR/FQR marker
# extraction workflow.
#
# ≥1 detected QR/FQR marker = "QR/FQR marker"
# no detected QR/FQR marker = "Q/FQ-susceptible"
# ============================================================

qr_isolates <- SEN_fqr_tokens %>%
  distinct(isolate_id) %>%
  mutate(QR_group = "QR/FQR marker")


SEN_year <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    isolate_id = as.character(.data[[id_col]])
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    qr_isolates,
    by = "isolate_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    QR_group = if_else(
      is.na(QR_group),
      "Q/FQ-susceptible",
      QR_group
    ),

    QR_group = factor(
      QR_group,
      levels = c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible",
        "QR/FQR marker"
      )
    )
  )


# Check classification
SEN_year %>%
  count(QR_group) %>%
  print(n = Inf)


# ============================================================
# 4) FIGURE 1:
#    NUMBER OF GENOMES BY COLLECTION YEAR
# ============================================================

yr_counts <- SEN_year %>%
  filter(!is.na(Collection_year)) %>%
  count(Collection_year, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    Collection_year = seq(
      min(Collection_year),
      max(Collection_year)
    ),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Collection_year)


p_years <- ggplot(
  yr_counts,
  aes(
    x = factor(Collection_year),
    y = n
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey40") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(n == 0, "", n)),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Collection year",
    y = "Number of genomes"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 5
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 8,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_years)


# ============================================================
# 5) FIGURE 2:
#    STACKED Q/FQ-SUSCEPTIBLE vs QR/FQR MARKER BY YEAR
# ============================================================

yr_qr <- SEN_year %>%
  filter(!is.na(Collection_year)) %>%
  count(
    Collection_year,
    QR_group,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    Collection_year = seq(
      min(Collection_year),
      max(Collection_year)
    ),
    QR_group = factor(
      c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible",
        "QR/FQR marker"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible",
        "QR/FQR marker"
      )
    ),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Collection_year,
    QR_group
  )


p_year_qr <- ggplot(
  yr_qr,
  aes(
    x = factor(Collection_year),
    y = n,
    fill = QR_group
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = ifelse(n == 0, "", n)
    ),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Q/FQ-susceptible" = "green4",
      "QR/FQR marker" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Collection year",
    y = "Number of genomes",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 5
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 8,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

print(p_year_qr)


# ============================================================
# 6) SAVE FIGURES
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  "SEN_collection_year_counts.png",
  p_years,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.5,
  dpi = 600
)

ggsave(
  "SEN_collection_year_counts.pdf",
  p_years,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.5
)


ggsave(
  "SEN_QRFQR_by_collection_year.png",
  p_year_qr,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.8,
  dpi = 600
)

ggsave(
  "SEN_QRFQR_by_collection_year.tif",
  p_year_qr,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.8,
  dpi = 600,

)

ggsave(
  "SEN_QRFQR_by_collection_year.pdf",

)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

    ),

      QR_group,
      levels = c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible",
        "QR/FQR marker"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# HELPER: MAKE PLOTS FOR A GIVEN YEAR WINDOW
# ============================================================

make_year_plots <- function(
    df,
    year_min = NULL,
    year_max = NULL,
    tag = "ALL"
) {

  d <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Collection_year))

  # Apply selected year range
  if (!is.null(year_min)) {
    d <- d %>%
      filter(Collection_year >= year_min)
  }

  if (!is.null(year_max)) {
    d <- d %>%
      filter(Collection_year <= year_max)
  }

  # Safety check
  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    warning(
      paste0(
        "No genomes found for year window: ",
        tag
      )
    )
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }


  # ==========================================================
  # 1) TOTAL GENOMES PER YEAR
  # ==========================================================

  yr_counts <- d %>%
    count(
      Collection_year,
      name = "n"
    ) %>%
    complete(
      Collection_year = seq(
        min(Collection_year),
        max(Collection_year)
      ),
      fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Collection_year)


  p_years <- ggplot(
    yr_counts,
    aes(
      x = factor(Collection_year),
      y = n
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      fill = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = ifelse(n == 0, "", n)
      ),
      vjust = -0.3,
      size = 2.2
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(0, 0.08)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Collection year",
      y = "Number of genomes",
      title = paste0(
        "Genome counts by collection year (",
        tag,
        ")"
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        vjust = 0.5,
        hjust = 1,
        size = 5
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 7
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 8,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 9,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  print(p_years)


  # ==========================================================
  # 2) Q/FQ-SUSCEPTIBLE vs QR/FQR MARKER PER YEAR
  # ==========================================================

  yr_qr <- d %>%
    count(
      Collection_year,
      QR_group,
      name = "n"
    ) %>%
    complete(
      Collection_year = seq(
        min(Collection_year),
        max(Collection_year)
      ),
      QR_group = factor(
        c(
          "Q/FQ-susceptible",
          "QR/FQR marker"
        ),
        levels = c(
          "Q/FQ-susceptible",
          "QR/FQR marker"
        )
      ),
      fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      Collection_year,
      QR_group
    )


  p_year_qr <- ggplot(
    yr_qr,
    aes(
      x = factor(Collection_year),
      y = n,
      fill = QR_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = ifelse(
          n == 0,
          "",
          n
        )
      ),
      position = position_stack(
        vjust = 0.5
      ),
      size = 2.2
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible" = "green4",
        "QR/FQR marker" = "red3"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Collection year",
      y = "Number of genomes",
      fill = "",
      title = paste0(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible vs QR/FQR marker by year (",
        tag,
        ")"
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        vjust = 0.5,
        hjust = 1,
        size = 5
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 7
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 8,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 9,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 8
      )
    )

  print(p_year_qr)


  # ==========================================================
  # RETURN PLOTS + DATA
  # ==========================================================

  invisible(
    list(
      counts_data = yr_counts,
      qr_data = yr_qr,
      counts_plot = p_years,
      qr_plot = p_year_qr
    )
  )
}
```

#7. looking deeply into Sources type
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# ---- standardize columns ----
SEN3 <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    Source_type = str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(`Source type`))),
    Source_type = if_else(is.na(Source_type) | Source_type == "", "unknown", Source_type),
    Isolation_source = str_trim(as.character(`Isolation source`)),
    Isolation_source = if_else(is.na(Isolation_source) | Isolation_source == "", "Unknown", Isolation_source)
  )

# ---- function: bar plot of Isolation source counts for one Source type ----
plot_iso_counts <- function(df, stype, top_n = 50) {
  dat <- df %>%
    filter(Source_type == stype) %>%
    count(Isolation_source, sort = TRUE, name = "n") %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    mutate(Isolation_source = factor(Isolation_source, levels = rev(Isolation_source)))

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = Isolation_source, y = n, fill = Isolation_source)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.2) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      x = "Isolation source",
      y = "Count",
      title = paste0("Isolation source counts (", stype, ")")
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.title  = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title  = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# ---- plots for requested source types ----
print(plot_iso_counts(SEN3, "animal"))
print(plot_iso_counts(SEN3, "environmental"))
print(plot_iso_counts(SEN3, "food"))
print(plot_iso_counts(SEN3, "unknown"))
```

#8. Reclassifying sources into Human, chicken and others

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    st  = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(`Source type`))),
    iso = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(`Isolation source`))),
    iso = if_else(is.na(iso), "", iso),

    # normalize: letters only + fix misspellings + split glued "chickenwings" etc.
    iso_norm = iso %>%
      str_replace_all("[^a-z]+", " ") %>%
      str_replace_all("chicken(?=[a-z])", "chicken ") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\bchicekn\\b", "chicken") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\bchikcen\\b", "chicken") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\bchcken\\b", "chicken") %>%
      str_squish(),

    Source = case_when(
      str_detect(st, "\\bhuman\\b") ~ "Human",

      # Chicken + egg + hatchery terms
      str_detect(
        iso_norm,
        paste0(
          "\\bchicken\\b|\\bchick\\b|\\bpoultry\\b|\\bhen\\b|",
          "\\bbroiler\\b|\\blayer\\b|\\bgallus\\b|gallus\\s+gallus|",
          "\\begg\\b|\\beggs\\b|\\begg\\s*product\\b|\\bproduct\\s*eggs\\b|\\begg\\s*yolk(s)?\\b|\\byolk(s)?\\b|",
          "\\bhatchery\\b|\\bhatching\\b|\\bhatcher(y)?\\b|",
          "\\bbox\\s*liner(s)?\\b|\\bliner(s)?\\b|\\bdrag\\s*swab(s)?\\b"
        )
      ) ~ "Chicken",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-st, -iso, -iso_norm)

SEN %>% count(Source, sort = TRUE)


```
#manually inspect others and improve 

# I manually inspected the other data and reassigned some samples back: further refined the Source classification for isolates initially labeled as “Other.”First, if the Host or IFSAC category fields contained any mention of “chicken,” these isolates were reclassified to the Chicken source. Second, if the Collected by field contained “CDC,” the isolate was reclassified to the Human source. After applying these rules, we recalculated the final counts of isolates per source category (Human, Chicken, Other, International).
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    Host_l   = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(Host))),
    Ifsac_l  = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(`IFSAC category`))),
    Collect_l = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(`Collected by`))),

    Source = case_when(
      # Reclassify "Other" to Chicken if Host or IFSAC mention chicken
      Source == "Other" & (
        str_detect(Host_l, "chicken") |
        str_detect(Ifsac_l, "chicken")
      ) ~ "Chicken",

      # Reclassify "Other" to Human if Collected by CDC
      Source == "Other" & str_detect(Collect_l, "cdc") ~ "Human",

      TRUE ~ Source
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-Host_l, -Ifsac_l, -Collect_l)

SEN %>% count(Source, sort = TRUE)



```

#10b. Inspect the other sources and re-classify sources into Turkey, cattel, Sheep/goat, Swin and Others

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================================
# REFINE THE CURRENT "Other" SOURCE CATEGORY
#
# New categories:
#   Turkey
#   Cattle
#   Sheep/goat
#   Swine
#   Others
#
# Original Source column is preserved.
# ============================================================

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    isolation_source_clean = `Isolation source` %>%
      as.character() %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_to_lower(),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Classify ONLY records currently designated Source = Other
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    Other_source_group = case_when(

      # ======================================================
      # TURKEY
      # Includes live-animal, cecal, meat and turkey products
      # ======================================================
      Source == "Other" &
        str_detect(
          isolation_source_clean,
          "\\bturkey\\b"
        ) ~ "Turkey",


      # ======================================================
      # CATTLE
      # Includes cattle, bovine, beef, steer, calf, Bos taurus
      # and beef products
      # ======================================================
      Source == "Other" &
        str_detect(
          isolation_source_clean,
          paste0(
            "\\b(",
            "cattle|",
            "bovine|",
            "beef|",
            "steer|",
            "calf|",
            "veal|",
            "bos taurus",
            ")\\b"
          )
        ) ~ "Cattle",


      # ======================================================
      # SHEEP / GOAT
      # Includes sheep, lamb, ovine, goat and caprine
      # ======================================================
      Source == "Other" &
        str_detect(
          isolation_source_clean,
          paste0(
            "\\b(",
            "sheep|",
            "lamb|",
            "ovine|",
            "goat|",
            "caprine",
            ")\\b"
          )
        ) ~ "Sheep/goat",


      # ======================================================
      # SWINE
      # Includes swine, sow, pork, porcine.
      #
      # Deliberately NOT using generic "pig" because
      # "guinea pig" occurs in your data and should remain Other.
      # ======================================================
      Source == "Other" &
        str_detect(
          isolation_source_clean,
          paste0(
            "\\b(",
            "swine|",
            "sow|",
            "pork|",
            "porcine",
            ")\\b"
          )
        ) ~ "Swine",


      # ======================================================
      # EVERYTHING ELSE CURRENTLY IN "Other"
      # ======================================================
      Source == "Other" ~ "Others",

      # Non-Other records left untouched here
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    Other_source_group = factor(
      Other_source_group,
      levels = c(
        "Turkey",
        "Cattle",
        "Sheep/goat",
        "Swine",
        "Others"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# CHECK COUNTS
# ============================================================

other_group_counts <- SEN %>%
  filter(Source == "Other") %>%
  count(
    Other_source_group,
    name = "n",
    sort = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = 100 * n / sum(n)
  )

print(other_group_counts, n = Inf)


# ============================================================
# SAVE SUMMARY
# ============================================================

write_csv(
  other_group_counts,
  "SEN_Other_source_refined_groups.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# AUDIT TABLE:
# See exactly how every Isolation source was classified
# ============================================================

other_source_audit <- SEN %>%
```

#11. reclassify FDA samples to seperate non-US sources isolated in the US
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

usa_pat <- "(\\busa\\b|\\bunited\\s*states\\b|\\bu\\s*\\.\\s*s\\s*\\.\\b|\\bus\\b)"
id_pat  <- "(\\bcfsan\\b|\\bfda\\b)"

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    Source = as.character(Source),

    Strain_l = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(Strain))),
    IsoID_l  = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(`Isolate identifiers`))),
    Strain_l = if_else(is.na(Strain_l), "", Strain_l),
    IsoID_l  = if_else(is.na(IsoID_l), "", IsoID_l),
    is_fda_like = str_detect(Strain_l, "^fda") | str_detect(IsoID_l, id_pat),

    Food_l = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(`Food origin`))),
    Food_l = if_else(is.na(Food_l), "", Food_l),

    # UPDATED: if FDA/CFSAN-linked but Food origin missing -> treat as US (no Unknown bucket)
    Origin_group = case_when(
      !is_fda_like ~ "US",
      Food_l == "" ~ "US",
      str_detect(Food_l, usa_pat) ~ "US",
      TRUE ~ "Non-US"
    ),

    Source_group = case_when(
      str_to_lower(Source) == "human" ~ "Human",
      str_to_lower(Source) == "chicken" ~ paste0("Chicken-", Origin_group),
      str_to_lower(Source) == "other"   ~ paste0("Other-", Origin_group),
      TRUE ~ paste0(Source, "-", Origin_group)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-Strain_l, -IsoID_l, -Food_l)

# Frequencies (no *-Unknown will exist now)
SEN %>%
  count(Source_group, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

SEN %>%
  count(Source, Origin_group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Origin_group, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  print(n = Inf)


SEN %>% count(Source, sort = TRUE)
```

#Decomposing Other-US sources and internation source to various source category
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

id_col <- "Isolate"

other_levels <- c(
  "Turkey",
  "Cattle",
  "Sheep/goat",
  "Swine",
  "Others"
)

international_levels <- c(
  "Chicken",
  "Turkey",
  "Cattle",
  "Sheep/goat",
  "Swine",
  "Others"
)

qr_levels <- c(
  "QS/FQS",
  "QR/FQR marker"
)


# ============================================================
# 0) CHECK RAW SEN INPUT
#
# This script starts from the RAW 33,831-genome SEN table.
# It does NOT require pre-existing:
#
#   Source
#   Origin_group
#   Other_source_group
#
# They are reconstructed below.
# ============================================================

required_raw_cols <- c(
  "Isolate",
  "Source type",
  "Isolation source",
  "Host",
  "IFSAC category",
  "Collected by",
  "Strain",
  "Isolate identifiers",
  "Food origin"
)

missing_raw_cols <- setdiff(
  required_raw_cols,
  names(SEN)
)

if (length(missing_raw_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Raw SEN is missing required column(s): ",
      paste(missing_raw_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("RAW SEN INPUT\n")
cat("========================================\n")

cat(
  "Rows =",
  nrow(SEN),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Unique isolates =",
  n_distinct(SEN[[id_col]]),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 1) HELPER: CLEAN TEXT
# ============================================================

clean_text <- function(x) {

  x <- str_squish(
    as.character(x)
  )

  x[is.na(x)] <- ""

  x
}


# ============================================================
# 2) RECONSTRUCT PRIMARY BIOLOGICAL SOURCE
#
# Final primary categories:
#
# Human
# Chicken
# Other
#
# Logic reproduces the production SEN workflow.
# ============================================================

classify_primary_source <- function(
    source_type,
    isolation_source,
    host,
    ifsac,
    collected_by
) {

  st <- str_to_lower(
    clean_text(source_type)
  )

  iso <- str_to_lower(
    clean_text(isolation_source)
  )


  # Normalize unusual chicken spellings / punctuation
  iso_norm <- iso %>%

    str_replace_all(
      "[^a-z]+",
      " "
    ) %>%

    str_replace_all(
      "chicken(?=[a-z])",
      "chicken "
    ) %>%

    str_replace_all(
      "\\bchicekn\\b|\\bchikcen\\b|\\bchcken\\b",
      "chicken"
    ) %>%

    str_squish()


  chicken_pat <- paste0(
    "\\bchicken\\b|",
    "\\bchick\\b|",
    "\\bpoultry\\b|",
    "\\bhen\\b|",
    "\\bbroiler\\b|",
    "\\blayer\\b|",
    "\\bgallus\\b|",
    "gallus\\s+gallus|",
    "\\begg\\b|",
    "\\beggs\\b|",
    "\\begg\\s*product\\b|",
    "\\bproduct\\s*eggs\\b|",
    "\\begg\\s*yolk(s)?\\b|",
    "\\byolk(s)?\\b|",
    "\\bhatchery\\b|",
    "\\bhatching\\b|",
    "\\bhatcher(y)?\\b|",
    "\\bbox\\s*liner(s)?\\b|",
    "\\bliner(s)?\\b|",
    "\\bdrag\\s*swab(s)?\\b"
  )


  src <- case_when(

    str_detect(
      st,
      "\\bhuman\\b"
    ) ~ "Human",

    str_detect(
      iso_norm,
      chicken_pat
    ) ~ "Chicken",

    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )


  host_l <- str_to_lower(
    clean_text(host)
  )

  ifsac_l <- str_to_lower(
    clean_text(ifsac)
  )

  collect_l <- str_to_lower(
    clean_text(collected_by)
  )


  # Further refinement
  src <- case_when(

    src == "Other" &
      (
        str_detect(
          host_l,
          "chicken"
        ) |
          str_detect(
            ifsac_l,
            "chicken"
          )
      ) ~ "Chicken",

    src == "Other" &
      str_detect(
        collect_l,
        "cdc"
      ) ~ "Human",

    TRUE ~ src
  )


  src
}


# ============================================================
# 3) CREATE PRIMARY SOURCE
# ============================================================

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(

    isolate_id = as.character(
      .data[[id_col]]
    ),

    Primary_source = classify_primary_source(
      `Source type`,
      `Isolation source`,
      Host,
      `IFSAC category`,
      `Collected by`
    )
  )


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("PRIMARY SOURCE COUNTS\n")
cat("========================================\n")

SEN %>%
  distinct(
    isolate_id,
    Primary_source
  ) %>%
  count(
    Primary_source,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  print(
    n = Inf
  )


# ============================================================
# 4) RECONSTRUCT US / NON-US ORIGIN
#
# This reproduces the FINAL production source logic.
#
# FDA/CFSAN-like isolates are identified from:
#
#   Strain
#   Isolate identifiers
#
# For those records:
#
#   explicit non-US Food origin -> Non-US
#   US / missing Food origin    -> US
#
# Other records default to US.
# ============================================================

usa_pat <- paste0(
  "(",
  "\\busa\\b|",
  "\\bunited\\s*states\\b|",
  "\\bu\\s*\\.\\s*s\\s*\\.\\b|",
  "\\bus\\b",
  ")"
)

id_pat <- "(\\bcfsan\\b|\\bfda\\b)"


SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(

    Strain_l = str_to_lower(
      clean_text(Strain)
    ),

    IsoID_l = str_to_lower(
      clean_text(`Isolate identifiers`)
    ),

    Food_l = str_to_lower(
      clean_text(`Food origin`)
    ),

    is_fda_like =
      str_detect(
        Strain_l,
        "^fda"
      ) |
      str_detect(
        IsoID_l,
        id_pat
      ),


    Origin_group = case_when(

      !is_fda_like ~
        "US",

      Food_l == "" ~
        "US",

      str_detect(
        Food_l,
        usa_pat
      ) ~
        "US",

      TRUE ~
        "Non-US"
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 5) BUILD SOURCE_GROUP AND FINAL SOURCE
#
# Examples:
#
# Human
# Chicken-US
# Other-US
# Chicken-Non-US
# Other-Non-US
#
# Both non-US animal groups are collapsed to:
#
# International
# ============================================================

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(

    Source_group = case_when(

      str_to_lower(
        Primary_source
      ) == "human" ~
        "Human",

      str_to_lower(
        Primary_source
      ) == "chicken" ~
        paste0(
          "Chicken-",
          Origin_group
        ),

      str_to_lower(
        Primary_source
      ) == "other" ~
        paste0(
          "Other-",
          Origin_group
        ),

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),


    Final_source = case_when(

      Source_group %in% c(
        "Chicken-Non-US",
        "Other-Non-US"
      ) ~
        "International",

      TRUE ~
        Source_group
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 6) VERIFY FULL 33,831-GENOME SOURCE COUNTS
# ============================================================

full_source_counts <- SEN %>%

  distinct(
    isolate_id,
    Final_source
  ) %>%

  count(
    Final_source,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(n)
  )


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("FINAL FULL-DATASET SOURCE COUNTS\n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(
  full_source_counts,
  n = Inf
)


cat(
  "\nTotal =",
  sum(full_source_counts$n),
  "\n"
)


# Expected final counts:
#
# Human          26,541
# Chicken-US      6,637
# Other-US          582
# International       71
# -----------------------
# Total           33,831


expected_counts <- tibble(
  Final_source = c(
    "Human",
    "Chicken-US",
    "Other-US",
    "International"
  ),

  expected_n = c(
    26541,
    6637,
    582,
    71
  )
)


source_validation <- full_source_counts %>%

  full_join(
    expected_counts,
    by = "Final_source"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    difference =
      n - expected_n
  )


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("SOURCE VALIDATION\n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(
  source_validation,
  n = Inf
)


if (
  any(
    source_validation$difference != 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Final source reconstruction does not match expected 33,831-genome source totals."
  )
}


cat("\n[PASS] Full source reconstruction matches.\n")
cat("[PASS] Other-US      = 582\n")
cat("[PASS] International = 71\n")


# ============================================================
# 7) DECOMPOSE FINAL OTHER SOURCE
#
# These categories are applied ONLY after the primary
# Human/Chicken/Other classification.
#
# This is important because we want to decompose the FINAL
# 582 Other-US isolates, not the old intermediate 515.
# ============================================================

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(

    Isolation_l = str_to_lower(
      clean_text(
        `Isolation source`
      )
    ),


    Other_source_group = case_when(

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # TURKEY
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      Primary_source == "Other" &
        str_detect(
          Isolation_l,
          "\\bturkey\\b"
        ) ~
        "Turkey",


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # CATTLE
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      Primary_source == "Other" &
        str_detect(
          Isolation_l,
          paste0(
            "\\b(",
            "cattle|",
            "bovine|",
            "beef|",
            "steer|",
            "calf|",
            "veal|",
            "bos taurus",
            ")\\b"
          )
        ) ~
        "Cattle",


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # SHEEP / GOAT
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      Primary_source == "Other" &
        str_detect(
          Isolation_l,
          paste0(
            "\\b(",
            "sheep|",
            "lamb|",
            "ovine|",
            "goat|",
            "caprine",
            ")\\b"
          )
        ) ~
        "Sheep/goat",


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # SWINE
      #
      # Generic "pig" remains excluded to avoid classifying
      # "guinea pig" as swine.
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      Primary_source == "Other" &
        str_detect(
          Isolation_l,
          paste0(
            "\\b(",
            "swine|",
            "sow|",
            "pork|",
            "porcine",
            ")\\b"
          )
        ) ~
        "Swine",


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # EVERYTHING ELSE WITH PRIMARY SOURCE = OTHER
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      Primary_source == "Other" ~
        "Others",

      TRUE ~
        NA_character_
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 8) BUILD FINAL INTERNATIONAL + OTHER-US TABLE
# ============================================================

source_animal_base <- SEN %>%

  filter(
    Final_source %in% c(
      "International",
      "Other-US"
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    Group = Final_source,


    Animal_source = case_when(

      # International chicken isolates
      Group == "International" &
        Primary_source == "Chicken" ~
        "Chicken",


      # International or US isolates whose primary source
      # remained Other use the reconstructed animal group
      Primary_source == "Other" ~
        Other_source_group,


      TRUE ~
        NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(
      Animal_source
    )
  ) %>%

  distinct(
    isolate_id,
    Group,
    Animal_source
  )


# ============================================================
# 9) DUPLICATE CHECK
# ============================================================

duplicate_check <- source_animal_base %>%

  count(
    isolate_id,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%

  filter(
    n > 1
  )


if (
  nrow(
    duplicate_check
  ) > 0
) {

  print(
    duplicate_check,
    n = Inf
  )

  stop(
    "Some isolates have more than one final animal-source assignment."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 10) CHECK FINAL GROUP TOTALS
# ============================================================

group_totals <- source_animal_base %>%

  count(
    Group,
    name = "n"
  )


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("FINAL INTERNATIONAL / OTHER-US TOTALS\n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(
  group_totals,
  n = Inf
)


international_n <- group_totals %>%
  filter(
    Group == "International"
  ) %>%
  pull(n)


otherUS_n <- group_totals %>%
  filter(
    Group == "Other-US"
  ) %>%
  pull(n)


stopifnot(
  length(international_n) == 1,
  length(otherUS_n) == 1,
  international_n == 71,
  otherUS_n == 582
)


cat("\n[PASS] International = 71\n")
cat("[PASS] Other-US      = 582\n")


# ============================================================
# 11) FINAL DECOMPOSITION
#
# THIS IS THE CRITICAL TABLE.
#
# It tells us exactly how the final 582 Other-US genomes
# are distributed.
# ============================================================

animal_source_totals <- source_animal_base %>%

  count(
    Group,
    Animal_source,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    Group
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    Group_total =
      sum(n),

    pct =
      100 * n / Group_total,

    pct_2dp =
      round(
        pct,
        2
      )
  ) %>%

  ungroup() %>%

  arrange(
    Group,
    desc(n)
  )


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("FINAL ANIMAL-SOURCE DECOMPOSITION\n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(
  animal_source_totals,
  n = Inf
)


# ============================================================
# 12) SUM CHECK
# ============================================================

decomposition_check <- animal_source_totals %>%

  group_by(
    Group
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    total = sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("DECOMPOSITION SUM CHECK\n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(
  decomposition_check,
  n = Inf
)


stopifnot(
  decomposition_check$total[
    decomposition_check$Group == "International"
  ] == 71
)

stopifnot(
  decomposition_check$total[
    decomposition_check$Group == "Other-US"
  ] == 582
)


# ============================================================
# 13) TABLE S1 READY OUTPUT
# ============================================================

table_S1_source <- animal_source_totals %>%

  transmute(

    `Source category` =
      Group,

    `Decomposed source information` =
      Animal_source,

    `Number of genomes (n)` =
      n,

    `Percentage of genomes (%)` =
      round(
        pct,
        2
      )
  )


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("TABLE S1 READY VALUES\n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(
  table_S1_source,
  n = Inf
)


write_csv(
  table_S1_source,
  "SEN_TableS1_final_source_decomposition.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# 14) COMPARE OLD OTHER-US 515 AGAINST FINAL 582
#
# Old supplementary table:
#
# Others       384
# Cattle        59
# Turkey        46
# Swine         21
# Sheep/goat     5
#
# Total        515
# ============================================================

old_otherUS <- tibble(

  Animal_source = c(
    "Others",
    "Cattle",
    "Turkey",
    "Swine",
    "Sheep/goat"
  ),

  old_n = c(
    384,
    59,
    46,
    21,
    5
  )
)


new_otherUS <- animal_source_totals %>%

  filter(
    Group == "Other-US"
  ) %>%

  select(
    Animal_source,
    final_n = n
  )


otherUS_old_vs_final <- full_join(
  new_otherUS,
  old_otherUS,
  by = "Animal_source"
) %>%

  mutate(

    final_n =
      replace_na(
        final_n,
        0L
      ),

    old_n =
      replace_na(
        old_n,
        0L
      ),

    difference =
      final_n - old_n,

    final_pct =
      round(
        100 * final_n / 582,
        2
      )
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(
      difference
    )
  )


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("WHERE DID THE EXTRA 67 OTHER-US GO?\n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(
  otherUS_old_vs_final,
  n = Inf
)


cat(
  "\nOld total   =",
  sum(
    otherUS_old_vs_final$old_n
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Final total =",
  sum(
    otherUS_old_vs_final$final_n
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Difference  =",
  sum(
    otherUS_old_vs_final$difference
  ),
  "\n"
)


stopifnot(
  sum(
    otherUS_old_vs_final$old_n
  ) == 515
)

stopifnot(
  sum(
    otherUS_old_vs_final$final_n
  ) == 582
)

stopifnot(
  sum(
    otherUS_old_vs_final$difference
  ) == 67
)


cat("\n[PASS] Exactly 67 additional Other-US isolates accounted for.\n")


write_csv(
  otherUS_old_vs_final,
  "SEN_OtherUS_old515_vs_final582.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# 15) QR/FQR STATUS
#
# Uses existing SEN_fqr_tokens.
# ============================================================

if (
  !exists(
    "SEN_fqr_tokens"
  )
) {

  stop(
    "SEN_fqr_tokens does not exist."
  )
}


if (
  !"isolate_id" %in%
    names(

    )

  stop(

  )
}


qr_isolates <- SEN_fqr_tokens %>%

  transmute(
    isolate_id =
      as.character(
        isolate_id
      )
  ) %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(
      isolate_id
    ),
    isolate_id != ""
  ) %>%

  distinct() %>%

  mutate(
    QR_status =
      "QR/FQR marker"
  )


# ============================================================
# 16) JOIN QR/FQR STATUS
# ============================================================

source_animal_qr <- source_animal_base %>%

  left_join(
    qr_isolates,
    by = "isolate_id"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    QR_status = if_else(
      is.na(
        QR_status
      ),
      "QS/FQS",
      QR_status
    ),

    QR_status = factor(
      QR_status,
      levels = qr_levels
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 17) OVERALL QR/FQR COUNTS
# ============================================================

group_qr_totals <- source_animal_qr %>%

  count(
    Group,
    QR_status,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    Group
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    total =
      sum(n),

    pct =
      round(
        100 * n / total,
        2
      )
  ) %>%

  ungroup()


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("OVERALL QR/FQR STATUS BY GROUP\n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(
  group_qr_totals,
  n = Inf
)


write_csv(
  group_qr_totals,
  "SEN_International_OtherUS_QRFQR_totals.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# 18) GROUP × ANIMAL SOURCE × QR/FQR STATUS
# ============================================================

animal_qr_counts <- source_animal_qr %>%

  count(
    Group,
    Animal_source,
    QR_status,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    Group,
    Animal_source
  ) %>%

  complete(
    QR_status = qr_levels,
    fill = list(
      n = 0
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    QR_status = factor(
      QR_status,
      levels = qr_levels
    ),

    total_source =
      sum(n),

    pct = if_else(
      total_source > 0,
      100 * n / total_source,
      0
    ),

    pct =
      round(
        pct,
        2
      ),

    label = if_else(
      n == 0,
      "",
      paste0(
        n,
        " (",
        sprintf(
          "%.1f",
          pct
        ),
        "%)"
      )
    )
  ) %>%

  ungroup()


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("ANIMAL SOURCE × QR/FQR STATUS\n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(
```

```{r}


# ============================================================
# SEN
# INTERNATIONAL + OTHER-US
# ANIMAL SOURCE AND QR/FQR ANALYSIS
#
# OUTPUT:
#   1. International original animal-source counts
#   2. International animal-source × QR/FQR
#   3. Other-US original animal-source counts
#   4. Other-US animal-source × QR/FQR
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 0) LIBRARIES
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)


id_col <- "Isolate"


# ============================================================
# 1) QR/FQR STATUS
#
# Uses the existing SEN_fqr_tokens object
# Any isolate present in SEN_fqr_tokens is classified as
# having a QR/FQR marker.
# ============================================================

qr_isolates <- SEN_fqr_tokens %>%
  distinct(isolate_id) %>%
  mutate(
    isolate_id = as.character(isolate_id),
    QR_status = "QR/FQR marker"
  )


# ============================================================
# 2) EXTRACT THE TWO CERTIFIED GROUPS
#
# International-Non-US -> International
# Other-US-US           -> Other-US
#
# Then refine animal source using Isolation source
# ============================================================

source_animal_qr <- SEN %>%

  filter(
    Source_group %in% c(
      "International-Non-US",
      "Other-US-US"
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    # Standardize isolate ID
    isolate_id = as.character(.data[[id_col]]),

    # Rename the two analysis groups
    Group = recode(
      Source_group,
      "International-Non-US" = "International",
      "Other-US-US" = "Other-US"
    ),

    # Clean Isolation source
    isolation_clean = str_to_lower(
      str_squish(
        as.character(`Isolation source`)
      )
    ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Animal-source classification
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Animal_source = case_when(

      # Chicken
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\b(chicken|broiler|hen)\\b"
      ) ~ "Chicken",

      # Turkey
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\bturkey\\b"
      ) ~ "Turkey",

      # Cattle
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\b(cattle|bovine|beef|steer|calf|veal|bos taurus)\\b"
      ) ~ "Cattle",

      # Sheep / goat
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\b(sheep|lamb|ovine|goat|caprine)\\b"
      ) ~ "Sheep/goat",

      # Swine
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\b(swine|sow|pork|porcine)\\b"
      ) ~ "Swine",

      # Everything else
      TRUE ~ "Others"
    )
  ) %>%

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # One row per isolate
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  distinct(
    isolate_id,
    Group,
    Animal_source
  ) %>%

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Add QR/FQR classification
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  left_join(
    qr_isolates,
    by = "isolate_id"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    # Anything not found in SEN_fqr_tokens is susceptible
    QR_status = if_else(
      is.na(QR_status),
      "Q/FQ-susceptible",
      QR_status
    ),

    QR_status = factor(
      QR_status,
      levels = c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible",
        "QR/FQR marker"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 3) CHECK TOTAL NUMBER OF ISOLATES
# ============================================================

group_totals <- source_animal_qr %>%
  count(
    Group,
    name = "n"
  )

print(
  group_totals,
  n = Inf
)


# Expected:
# International = 71
# Other-US      = 515


# ============================================================
# 4) ORIGINAL ANIMAL-SOURCE COUNTS
#
# These counts ignore QR/FQR status.
# They simply describe the original animal-source composition
# of International and Other-US isolates.
# ============================================================

animal_original_counts <- source_animal_qr %>%

  count(
    Group,
    Animal_source,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%

  group_by(Group) %>%

  mutate(
    group_total = sum(n),
    pct = 100 * n / group_total,
    label = paste0(
      n,
      " (",
      sprintf("%.1f", pct),
      "%)"
    )
  ) %>%

  ungroup()


print(
  animal_original_counts,
  n = Inf
)


write_csv(
  animal_original_counts,
  "SEN_International_OtherUS_animal_original_counts.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# 5) COUNTS BY
#    GROUP × ANIMAL SOURCE × QR STATUS
# ============================================================

animal_qr_counts <- source_animal_qr %>%

  count(
    Group,
    Animal_source,
    QR_status,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    Group,
    Animal_source
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    total_source = sum(n),

    pct = 100 * n / total_source,

    label = paste0(
      n,
      " (",
      sprintf("%.1f", pct),
      "%)"
    )
  ) %>%

  ungroup()


print(
  animal_qr_counts,
  n = Inf
)


write_csv(
  animal_qr_counts,
  "SEN_International_OtherUS_animal_QRFQR_counts.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# 6) FACTOR ORDERS
# ============================================================

international_levels <- c(
  "Chicken",
  "Turkey",
  "Cattle",
  "Sheep/goat",
  "Swine",
  "Others"
)


otherUS_levels <- c(
  "Turkey",
  "Cattle",
  "Sheep/goat",
  "Swine",
  "Others"
)


# ============================================================
# 7) INTERNATIONAL DATA
# ============================================================

international_original_df <- animal_original_counts %>%

  filter(
    Group == "International"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    Animal_source = factor(
      Animal_source,
      levels = international_levels
    )
  )


international_qr_df <- animal_qr_counts %>%

  filter(
    Group == "International"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    Animal_source = factor(
```

#12. Plot the trend for the different QR-markers in al the different sources
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)   # for unit()

amr_col <- "AMR genotypes"

# -----------------------------
# Helper: bin % into categories
# -----------------------------
pct_bins <- function(x) {
  cut(
    x,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 5, 10, 20, 40, 50, 60, 80, Inf),
    labels = c(
      "0",
      "1-5",
      "6-10",
      "10-20",
      "20-40",
      "40-50",
      "50-60",
      "60-80",
      "80+"
    ),
    right = TRUE
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Helper: pretty/correct gene casing for display
# -----------------------------
pretty_token <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_trim(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "\\s+", "")

  # normalize delimiters
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "-", "_")

  fix_start <- function(s, from, to) {
    str_replace(s, paste0("^", from), to)
  }

  # chromosomal targets
  x <- fix_start(x, "gyra", "gyrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "gyrb", "gyrB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "parc", "parC")
  x <- fix_start(x, "pare", "parE")
  x <- fix_start(x, "pard", "parD")
  x <- fix_start(x, "grla", "grlA")

  # qnr family
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnras", "qnrAS")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnra",  "qnrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrb",  "qnrB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrc",  "qnrC")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrd",  "qnrD")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnre",  "qnrE")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrs",  "qnrS")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrvc", "qnrVC")

  # other families
  x <- fix_start(x, "qepa", "qepA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "nfxb", "nfxB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "emrr", "emrR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "norm", "norM")
  x <- fix_start(x, "pmra", "pmrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "acrb", "acrB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "smef", "smeF")

  # prior extras
  x <- fix_start(x, "acra", "acrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "tolc", "tolC")
  x <- fix_start(x, "crpp", "crpP")
  x <- fix_start(x, "oqxa", "oqxA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "oqxb", "oqxB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "rama", "ramA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "ramr", "ramR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "mara", "marA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "marr", "marR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "soxr", "soxR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "soxs", "soxS")

  # enzyme token
  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    "^aac\\(6'\\)-ib-cr",
    "aac(6')-Ib-cr"
  )

  # uppercase mutation/suffix after underscore
  parts <- str_split_fixed(x, "_", 2)

  gene_part <- parts[, 1]
  rest_part <- parts[, 2]

  rest_part <- ifelse(
    rest_part == "",
    rest_part,
    toupper(rest_part)
  )

  x <- ifelse(
    rest_part == "",
    gene_part,
    paste0(gene_part, "_", rest_part)
  )

  x
}


# =========================================================
# 0) Assign origin (US vs Non-US), then build Source groups
#    Collapse ALL Non-US into "International"
# =========================================================

usa_pat <- "(\\busa\\b|\\bunited\\s*states\\b|\\bu\\s*\\.\\s*s\\s*\\.\\b|\\bus\\b)"
id_pat  <- "(\\bcfsan\\b|\\bfda\\b)"

source_levels <- c(
  "Human",
  "Chicken-US",
  "Other-US",
  "International"
)

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    Source = as.character(Source),

    Strain_l = str_to_lower(
      str_squish(as.character(Strain))
    ),

    IsoID_l = str_to_lower(
      str_squish(as.character(`Isolate identifiers`))
    ),

    Food_l = str_to_lower(
      str_squish(as.character(`Food origin`))
    ),

    Strain_l = if_else(
      is.na(Strain_l),
      "",
      Strain_l
    ),

    IsoID_l = if_else(
      is.na(IsoID_l),
      "",
      IsoID_l
    ),

    Food_l = if_else(
      is.na(Food_l),
      "",
      Food_l
    ),

    is_fda_like =
      str_detect(Strain_l, "^fda") |
      str_detect(IsoID_l, id_pat),

    is_us_food =
      str_detect(Food_l, usa_pat) |
      Food_l == "",

    origin_tag = if_else(
      is_fda_like & !is_us_food,
      "Non-US",
      "US"
    ),

    Source = case_when(
      str_to_lower(Source) == "human" ~
        "Human",

      str_to_lower(Source) == "chicken" ~
        paste0("Chicken-", origin_tag),

      str_to_lower(Source) == "other" ~
        paste0("Other-", origin_tag),

      TRUE ~ Source
    ),

    Source = case_when(
      Source %in% c(
        "Chicken-Non-US",
        "Other-Non-US"
      ) ~ "International",

      TRUE ~ Source
    ),

    Source = factor(
      Source,
      levels = source_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    -Strain_l,
    -IsoID_l,
    -Food_l,
    -is_fda_like,
    -is_us_food,
    -origin_tag
  )


# =========================================================
# N per Source for facet labels
# =========================================================

src_N <- SEN %>%
  count(
    Source,
    name = "N_total"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Source_chr = as.character(Source),

    Source_lab = paste0(
      Source_chr,
      " (N=",
      N_total,
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(
      Source_chr,
      levels = source_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Source_lab = factor(
      Source_lab,
      levels = Source_lab
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Source,
    Source_lab
  )


# =========================================================
# 1) TOKENIZE + keep ALL QR tokens
# =========================================================

qr_regex <- regex(
  paste0(
    "^(",
    "(gyr[a-b](?:_.+)?|par[c-e](?:_.+)?|grla(?:_.+)?)(?:$)|",
    "(qnr(as|[a-z0-9._-]*))(?:$)|",
    "(qnrvc[a-z0-9._-]*)(?:$)|",
    "(qep[a-z0-9._-]*)(?:$)|",
    "(nfxb(?:_.+)?|emrr(?:_.+)?|norm(?:_.+)?|pmra(?:_.+)?|acrb(?:_.+)?|smef(?:_.+)?)(?:$)|",
    "(aac\\(6'\\)-ib-cr(?:_.+)?|oqx[a-b](?:_.+)?|crpp(?:_.+)?|acr[a-b](?:_.+)?|tolc(?:_.+)?|ram[ar](?:_.+)?|mar[ar](?:_.+)?|sox[rs](?:_.+)?)(?:$)",
    ")"
  ),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)


tok_long <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),

    Collection_year = as.integer(
      Collection_year
    ),

    amr_txt = as.character(
      .data[[amr_col]]
    ),

    amr_txt = if_else(
      is.na(amr_txt),
      "",
      amr_txt
    ),

    token = str_extract_all(
      amr_txt,
      "[^,=\\s]+(?==)"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    row_id,
    Source,
    Collection_year,
    token
  ) %>%
  unnest_longer(
    token
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    token = str_trim(token),

    token = str_replace_all(
      token,
      "\\s+",
      ""
    ),

    token_norm = str_to_lower(
      token
    ),

    token_pretty = pretty_token(
      token_norm
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Collection_year),
    Collection_year >= 1990,
    Collection_year <= 2025
  )


tok_qr <- tok_long %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      token_norm,
      qr_regex
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 2) Pick TOP 5 QR TOKENS overall
#    rest -> "others"
# =========================================================

top5_tokens <- tok_qr %>%
  count(
    token_pretty,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(n)
  ) %>%
  slice_head(
    n = 5
  ) %>%
  pull(
    token_pretty
  )


marker_long <- tok_qr %>%
  mutate(
    marker_group = if_else(
      token_pretty %in% top5_tokens,
      token_pretty,
      "others"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    row_id,
    Source,
    Collection_year,
    marker_group
  )


top5_lower <- str_to_lower(
  top5_tokens
)

top5_ordered <- c(

  top5_tokens[
    str_detect(
      top5_lower,
      "^gyra(_|$)"
    )
  ],

  top5_tokens[
    str_detect(
      top5_lower,
      "^qnrb"
    )
  ],

  top5_tokens[
    !str_detect(
      top5_lower,
      "^gyra(_|$)"
    ) &
      !str_detect(
        top5_lower,
        "^qnrb"
      )
  ]
)

top5_ordered <- unique(
  top5_ordered
)

marker_levels <- c(
  top5_ordered,
  "others"
)

    Source,
    year5,
    marker_group,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    Source = factor(
      source_levels,
      levels = source_levels
    ),

    year5 = year5_levels,

    marker_group = marker_levels,

    fill = list(
      n = 0
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    den_5 %>%
      complete(
        Source = factor(
          source_levels,
          levels = source_levels
        ),

        year5 = year5_levels,

        fill = list(
          N = 0
        )
      ),

    by = c(
      "Source",
      "year5"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = if_else(
      N > 0,
      100 * n / N,
      0
    ),

    pct_bin = pct_bins(
      pct
    ),

    pct_bin = factor(
      pct_bin,
      levels = c(
        "0",
        "1-5",
        "6-10",
        "10-20",
        "20-40",
        "40-50",
        "50-60",
        "60-80",
        "80+"
      )
    ),

    year5 = factor(
      year5,
      levels = year5_levels
    ),

    marker_group = factor(
      marker_group,
      levels = marker_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    src_N,
    by = "Source"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Source_lab = factor(
      Source_lab,
      levels = levels(
        src_N$Source_lab
      )
    )
  )


p_5_binned <- ggplot(
  marker_5,
  aes(
    x = year5,
    y = marker_group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      size = pct,
      color = pct_bin
    ),
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Source_lab,
    ncol = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "5-year bin",
    y = "QR/FQR Markers",
    color = "Percent (%) bin",
    size = "Percent (%) magnitude"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 8
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 7
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 7
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# Prevent circles touching facet borders
# =========================================================

y_pad <- expansion(
  mult = c(
    0.30,
    0.30
  )
)

panel_gap <- unit(
  0.50,
  "lines"
)


p_year_binned <- p_year_binned +
  scale_y_discrete(
    expand = y_pad
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = panel_gap,

    strip.background = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),

    strip.placement = "outside"
  )


p_5_binned <- p_5_binned +
  scale_y_discrete(
    expand = y_pad
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = panel_gap,

    strip.background = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),

    strip.placement = "outside"
  )


# =========================================================
# PRINT
# =========================================================

print(p_year_binned)
print(p_5_binned)


# =========================================================
# SAVE
#
# Original height = 6
# Width reduced by 10%:
# 9 -> 8.1
# =========================================================

ggsave(
  "FQ_burden.png",
  p_year_binned,
  width = 8.1,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 1200
)

ggsave(
  "FQ_burden.tif",
  p_year_binned,
  width = 8.1,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw"
)

ggsave(
  "FQ_burden_5yr.png",
  p_5_binned,
  width = 8.1,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 1200
)

ggsave(
  "FQ_burden_5yr.tif",
  p_5_binned,
  width = 8.1,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw"
)
```
