#stacked bar plot over time
```{r}

# =========================================================
# STACKED BAR PLOTS:
#
# 1. PERCENT VERSION
# 2. COUNT VERSION
#
# QR/FQR   = red3
# QS/FQS   = green4
#
# Same years as dot plot:
#   ≤2000
#   2001
#   2002
#   ...
#   2025
#
# Years with NO genomes have NO bar.
#
# COUNT VERSION:
# Total genome count is written vertically above each bar.
# =========================================================


# =========================================================
# 1) IDENTIFY GENOMES WITH ≥1 QR/FQR MARKER
# =========================================================

qr_positive_rows <- tok_qr %>%
  distinct(
    row_id
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    QR_status = "QR/FQR"
  )


# =========================================================
# 2) ASSIGN ONE QR/FQR STATUS TO EVERY GENOME
#
# ≥1 QR/FQR marker  -> QR/FQR
# no QR/FQR marker  -> QS/FQS
# =========================================================

SEN_qr_status <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),

    Collection_year = as.integer(
      Collection_year
    ),

    year_plot = if_else(
      Collection_year <= 2000,
      "≤2000",
      as.character(
        Collection_year
      )
    )
  ) %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(Collection_year),
    Collection_year >= 1990,
    Collection_year <= 2025
  ) %>%

  left_join(
    qr_positive_rows,
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    QR_status = if_else(
      is.na(QR_status),
      "QS/FQS",
      QR_status
    ),

    QR_status = factor(
      QR_status,
      levels = c(
        "QS/FQS",
        "QR/FQR"
      )
    ),

    year_plot = factor(
      year_plot,
      levels = year_levels
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 3) COUNT GENOMES PER
#    SOURCE × YEAR × QR/FQR STATUS
#
# IMPORTANT:
# We deliberately DO NOT use complete() here.
#
# Therefore:
#   N = 0 -> NO BAR
#
# But scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) below keeps the
# corresponding year position visible on the x-axis.
# =========================================================

year_qr_stack <- SEN_qr_status %>%
  count(
    Source,
    year_plot,
    QR_status,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    Source,
    year_plot
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    N_year = sum(n),

    pct = 100 * n / N_year
  ) %>%

  ungroup() %>%

  left_join(
    src_N,
    by = "Source"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    Source_lab = factor(
      Source_lab,
      levels = levels(
        src_N$Source_lab
      )
    ),

    year_plot = factor(
      year_plot,
      levels = year_levels
    ),

    QR_status = factor(
      QR_status,
      levels = c(
        "QS/FQS",
        "QR/FQR"
      )
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 4) CREATE ONE TOTAL COUNT PER SOURCE × YEAR
#
# This is used ONLY for writing the total number of
# genomes above each stacked bar in the count plot.
# =========================================================

year_qr_totals <- year_qr_stack %>%
  distinct(
    Source,
    Source_lab,
    year_plot,
    N_year
  )


# =========================================================
# 5) OPTIONAL CHECK OF DATA USED IN BOTH PLOTS
# =========================================================

print(
  year_qr_stack,
  n = Inf
)

print(
  year_qr_totals,
  n = Inf
)


# =========================================================
# 6) PERCENTAGE STACKED BAR PLOT
#
# Every bar represents 100% of genomes sampled from
# that Source during that year.
# =========================================================

p_year_qr_stack_pct <- ggplot(
  year_qr_stack,
  aes(
    x = year_plot,
    y = pct,
    fill = QR_status
  )
) +

  geom_col(
    width = 0.82
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ Source_lab,
    ncol = 1
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "QS/FQS" = "green4",
      "QR/FQR" = "red3"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      100
    ),

    breaks = seq(
      0,
      100,
      20
    ),

    labels = function(x) {
      paste0(
        x,
        "%"
      )
    },

    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0
      )
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Collection year",
    y = "Genomes (%)",
    fill = ""
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 7
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 7
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    panel.spacing = unit(
      0.50,
      "lines"
    ),

    strip.background = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),

    strip.placement = "outside"
  )


# =========================================================
# 7) COUNT STACKED BAR PLOT
#
# Bar height = actual number of genomes
#
# Green component:
#   QS/FQS genomes
#
# Red component:
#   QR/FQR genomes
#
# Total N is written vertically above each bar.
#
# Y-axis:
#   whole numbers only
#
# Extra upper space:
#   allows all vertical N labels to show clearly
# =========================================================


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# FUNCTION FOR INTEGER-ONLY Y-AXIS BREAKS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

integer_breaks <- function(x) {

  b <- pretty(
    x,
    n = 5
  )

  b <- b[
    b >= 0 &
    b >= x[1] &
    b <= x[2] &
    abs(b - round(b)) < 1e-8
  ]

  unique(
    as.integer(
      round(b)
    )
  )
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# COUNT PLOT
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_year_qr_stack_count <- ggplot(
  year_qr_stack,
  aes(
    x = year_plot,
    y = n,
    fill = QR_status
  )
) +

  geom_col(
    width = 0.82
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # TOTAL GENOME NUMBER ABOVE EACH BAR
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  geom_text(
    data = year_qr_totals,

    aes(
      x = year_plot,
      y = N_year,
      label = N_year
    ),

    inherit.aes = FALSE,

    angle = 90,

    hjust = 0,

    vjust = 0.5,

    size = 2.2
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ Source_lab,
    ncol = 1,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "QS/FQS" = "green4",
      "QR/FQR" = "red3"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Y AXIS
  #
  # 50% additional space above tallest bar in each panel.
  #
  # Breaks are restricted to whole numbers.
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  scale_y_continuous(

    breaks = integer_breaks,

    labels = function(x) {
      as.integer(x)
    },

    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0.50
      )
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Collection year",
    y = "Genomes (n)",
    fill = ""
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 7
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 7
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    panel.spacing = unit(
      0.50,
      "lines"
    ),

    strip.background = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),

    strip.placement = "outside"
  )


# =========================================================
# PRINT COUNT PLOT
# =========================================================

print(
  p_year_qr_stack_count
)


# =========================================================
# SAVE COUNT VERSION
# =========================================================

ggsave(
  "FQ_QRFQR_vs_QFQsusceptible_COUNT_by_year.png",
  p_year_qr_stack_count,
  width = 8.1,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 1200
)

ggsave(
  "FQ_QRFQR_vs_QFQsusceptible_COUNT_by_year.tif",
  p_year_qr_stack_count,
  width = 8.1,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw"
)

# =========================================================
# 8) PRINT BOTH
# =========================================================

print(
  p_year_qr_stack_pct
)

print(
  p_year_qr_stack_count
)


# =========================================================
# 9) SAVE PERCENTAGE VERSION
#
# PNG = 1200 dpi
# TIFF = 600 dpi
# =========================================================

ggsave(
  "FQ_QRFQR_vs_QFQsusceptible_PERCENT_by_year.png",
  p_year_qr_stack_pct,
  width = 8.1,

)

ggsave(

# =========================================================
```

#visualize the temperol trend based on FQR markers 
```{r}

# =========================================================
# EXPANDED QS/FQS + QR/FQR MARKER STACKED BAR PLOTS
#
# TWO OUTPUTS:
#
# 1. PERCENTAGE
# 2. COUNT
#
# STACK COMPONENTS:
#
#   QS/FQS
#   Top QR/FQR marker 1
#   Top QR/FQR marker 2
#   Top QR/FQR marker 3
#   Top QR/FQR marker 4
#   Top QR/FQR marker 5
#   others
#
# IMPORTANT:
#
# QS/FQS IS DISPLAYED AT THE TOP OF EACH STACKED BAR.
#
# Interpretation:
#
# QS/FQS = genomes with no detected QR/FQR marker
#
# QR/FQR = decomposed into:
#          Top 5 individual markers + others
#
# Requires existing objects from the main workflow:
#
#   SEN
#   marker_long
#   top5_ordered
#   src_N
#
# =========================================================


library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)


# =========================================================
# 1) YEAR LEVELS
# =========================================================

year_levels <- c(
  "≤2000",
  as.character(2001:2025)
)


# =========================================================
# 2) INTEGER-ONLY Y-AXIS BREAKS
# =========================================================

integer_breaks <- function(x) {

  b <- pretty(
    x,
    n = 5
  )

  b <- b[
    b >= 0 &
      b >= x[1] &
      b <= x[2] &
      abs(b - round(b)) < 1e-8
  ]

  unique(
    as.integer(
      round(b)
    )
  )
}


# =========================================================
# 3) CREATE BASE TABLE OF ALL GENOMES
#
# Every genome occurs exactly once here.
# This is the TRUE population denominator.
# =========================================================

all_genomes_year <- SEN %>%

  mutate(

    row_id = row_number(),

    Collection_year = as.integer(
      Collection_year
    ),

    year_plot = if_else(
      Collection_year <= 2000,
      "≤2000",
      as.character(Collection_year)
    )
  ) %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(Collection_year),
    Collection_year >= 1990,
    Collection_year <= 2025
  ) %>%

  select(
    row_id,
    Source,
    Collection_year,
    year_plot
  )


# =========================================================
# 4) TRUE TOTAL NUMBER OF GENOMES
#    PER SOURCE × YEAR
#
# This is calculated from ALL genomes,
# not marker observations.
# =========================================================

true_year_totals <- all_genomes_year %>%

  count(
    Source,
    year_plot,
    name = "N_year"
  )


# =========================================================
# 5) QR/FQR MARKER ASSIGNMENTS
#
# marker_long comes from the main QR/FQR workflow.
#
# marker_group contains:
#
#   Top 5 individual QR/FQR markers
#   others
#
# =========================================================

qr_assignments <- marker_long %>%

  select(
    row_id,
    marker_group
  ) %>%

  distinct()


# =========================================================
# 6) MARKER MULTIPLICITY QC
#
# Reports how many QR/FQR-positive genomes have:
#
# 1 marker
# 2 markers
# 3 markers
# etc.
# =========================================================

marker_multiplicity <- qr_assignments %>%

  count(
    row_id,
    name = "n_marker_groups"
  ) %>%

  count(
    n_marker_groups,
    name = "n_genomes"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    pct = 100 *
      n_genomes /
      sum(n_genomes)
  )


cat(
  "\n========================================\n"
)

cat(
  "QR/FQR MARKER MULTIPLICITY\n"
)

cat(
  "========================================\n"
)

print(
  marker_multiplicity,
  n = Inf
)


# =========================================================
# 7) IDENTIFY QR/FQR-POSITIVE GENOMES
#
# Any genome occurring here has ≥1 detected
# QR/FQR marker.
# =========================================================

qr_positive_rows <- qr_assignments %>%

  distinct(
    row_id
  )


# =========================================================
# 8) IDENTIFY QS/FQS GENOMES
#
# Any genome NOT found among QR/FQR-positive genomes
# is classified as:
#
# QS/FQS
# =========================================================

susceptible_rows <- all_genomes_year %>%

  anti_join(
    qr_positive_rows,
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    marker_group = "QS/FQS"
  ) %>%

  select(
    row_id,
    Source,
    Collection_year,
    year_plot,
    marker_group
  )


# =========================================================
# 9) CREATE QR/FQR MARKER ROWS
#
# QR/FQR-positive genomes retain their individual
# Top-5 / others marker classification.
# =========================================================

qr_marker_rows <- all_genomes_year %>%

  inner_join(
    qr_assignments,
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%

  select(
    row_id,
    Source,
    Collection_year,
    year_plot,
    marker_group
  )


# =========================================================
# 10) COMBINE QS/FQS + QR/FQR MARKERS
#
# Final categories:
#
#   QS/FQS
#   Top 5 QR/FQR markers
#   others
#
# =========================================================

expanded_genome_marker <- bind_rows(

  susceptible_rows,

  qr_marker_rows
)


# =========================================================
# 11) DEFINE STACK ORDER
#
# QS/FQS is the FIRST factor level.
#
# With normal ggplot stacking (reverse = FALSE),
# QS/FQS will be displayed AT THE TOP of the bar.
# =========================================================

expanded_marker_levels <- c(

  "QS/FQS",

  top5_ordered,

  "others"
)


expanded_genome_marker <- expanded_genome_marker %>%

  mutate(

    marker_group = factor(
      marker_group,
      levels = expanded_marker_levels
    ),

    year_plot = factor(
      year_plot,
      levels = year_levels
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 12) COUNT EACH CATEGORY
#
# Source × Year × Category
# =========================================================

expanded_stack <- expanded_genome_marker %>%

  count(
    Source,
    year_plot,
    marker_group,
    name = "n"
  )


# =========================================================
# 13) ADD TRUE YEAR DENOMINATOR
#
# Percentage denominator is the actual number
# of sampled genomes for that Source × Year.
# =========================================================

expanded_stack <- expanded_stack %>%

  left_join(

    true_year_totals,

    by = c(
      "Source",
      "year_plot"
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    pct = 100 *
      n /
      N_year
  )


# =========================================================
# 14) ADD SOURCE FACET LABELS
# =========================================================

expanded_stack <- expanded_stack %>%

  left_join(
    src_N,
    by = "Source"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    Source_lab = factor(
      Source_lab,
      levels = levels(
        src_N$Source_lab
      )
    ),

    year_plot = factor(
      year_plot,
      levels = year_levels
    ),

    marker_group = factor(
      marker_group,
      levels = expanded_marker_levels
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 15) TRUE TOTAL LABEL TABLE
#
# Used for labels above count bars.
#
# N = true number of sampled genomes.
# =========================================================

expanded_totals <- true_year_totals %>%

  left_join(
    src_N,
    by = "Source"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    Source_lab = factor(
      Source_lab,
      levels = levels(
        src_N$Source_lab
      )
    ),

    year_plot = factor(
      year_plot,
      levels = year_levels
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 16) DATA CHECK
# =========================================================

cat(
  "\n========================================\n"
)

cat(
  "QS/FQS + QR/FQR EXPANDED STACK DATA\n"
)

cat(
  "========================================\n"
)

print(
  expanded_stack,
  n = Inf
)


# =========================================================
# 17) VALIDATE STACK HEIGHT
#
# Because ~99.5% of QR/FQR-positive genomes carry
# a single marker, stacked N should be almost
# identical to the true genome N.
#
# excess_n identifies genomes contributing more
# than one QR/FQR marker category.
# =========================================================

stack_check <- expanded_stack %>%

  group_by(
    Source,
    year_plot
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    stacked_n = sum(n),

    N_year = first(N_year),

    stacked_pct = sum(pct),

    excess_n =
      stacked_n -
      N_year,

    excess_pct =
      stacked_pct -
      100,

    .groups = "drop"
  )


cat(
  "\n========================================\n"
)

cat(
  "STACK VALIDATION\n"
)

cat(
  "========================================\n"
)

print(
  stack_check,
  n = Inf
)


# =========================================================
# 18) COLORS
#
# QS/FQS = GREEN
#
# Individual QR/FQR mechanisms receive
# distinct colors.
# =========================================================

n_qr_categories <- length(
  expanded_marker_levels
) - 1


qr_colors <- grDevices::hcl.colors(
  n_qr_categories,
  palette = "Dark 3"
)


expanded_colors <- c(

  "QS/FQS" = "green4",

  setNames(

    qr_colors,

    expanded_marker_levels[
      expanded_marker_levels !=
        "QS/FQS"
    ]
  )
)


# =========================================================
# 19) PERCENTAGE STACKED BAR
#
# Entire population:
#
# QS/FQS
# +
# Top 5 QR/FQR markers
# +
# others
#
```

#Diversity and Enrichment score and Plotting
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# =========================================================
# A) Build iso_mat from marker_long (one row per isolate)
# =========================================================
source_levels <- c("Human", "Chicken-US", "Other-US", "International")

iso_mat <- marker_long %>%
  mutate(value = 1L) %>%
  select(row_id, Source, marker_group, value) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(row_id, Source),
    names_from  = marker_group,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = list(value = 0L)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Source = factor(as.character(Source), levels = source_levels))

# ensure marker_levels match the columns in iso_mat
marker_levels <- setdiff(names(iso_mat), c("row_id", "Source"))

# =========================================================
# B) Hill numbers helper (q0, q1, q2)
# =========================================================
hill_numbers <- function(p) {
  p <- as.numeric(p)
  p <- p[is.finite(p) & p > 0]
  if (length(p) == 0) return(c(q0 = 0, q1 = 0, q2 = 0))
  q0 <- length(p)
  q1 <- exp(-sum(p * log(p)))   # Exponential Shannon
  q2 <- 1 / sum(p^2)            # Inverse Simpson
  c(q0 = q0, q1 = q1, q2 = q2)
}

# =========================================================
# C) Point estimates q0/q1/q2 per Source
# =========================================================
div_point <- iso_mat %>%
  group_by(Source) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    across(all_of(marker_levels), ~ mean(.x)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    s = sum(c_across(all_of(marker_levels))),
    p = list(if (s > 0) c_across(all_of(marker_levels)) / s else rep(0, length(marker_levels))),
    q0 = hill_numbers(unlist(p))["q0"],
    q1 = hill_numbers(unlist(p))["q1"],
    q2 = hill_numbers(unlist(p))["q2"]
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Source, N, q0, q1, q2) %>%
  arrange(Source)

# =========================================================
# D) Bootstrap 95% CI for q0/q1/q2
# =========================================================
set.seed(1)
B <- 1000

boot_source <- function(df_source) {
  X <- as.matrix(df_source[, marker_levels, drop = FALSE])
  n <- nrow(X)
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = B, ncol = 3)
  colnames(out) <- c("q0", "q1", "q2")
  if (n == 0) return(as.data.frame(out))

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    idx <- sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    prev <- colMeans(X[idx, , drop = FALSE])
    s <- sum(prev)
    p <- if (s > 0) prev / s else rep(0, length(prev))
    out[b, ] <- hill_numbers(p)
  }
  as.data.frame(out)
}

boot_res <- split(iso_mat, iso_mat$Source) %>%
  lapply(boot_source) %>%
  Map(function(df, nm) { df$Source <- nm; df }, ., names(.)) %>%
  bind_rows()

div_ci <- boot_res %>%
  group_by(Source) %>%
  summarise(
    q0_lo = quantile(q0, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q0_hi = quantile(q0, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_lo = quantile(q1, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_hi = quantile(q1, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    q2_lo = quantile(q2, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q2_hi = quantile(q2, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

div_sum <- div_point %>%
  left_join(div_ci, by = "Source") %>%
  mutate(Source = factor(as.character(Source), levels = source_levels)) %>%
  arrange(Source)

print(div_sum, n = Inf)
write.csv(div_sum, "QR_diversity_q0_q1_q2_bySource_with95CI.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# =========================================================
# E) Composition table from iso_mat
# =========================================================
comp_tbl <- iso_mat %>%
  group_by(Source) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(marker_levels), ~ mean(.x)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(marker_levels),
    names_to = "marker_group",
    values_to = "prevalence"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Source) %>%
  mutate(
    denom = sum(prevalence),
    p = if_else(denom > 0, prevalence / denom, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-denom) %>%
  mutate(
    Source = factor(as.character(Source), levels = source_levels),
    marker_group = factor(marker_group, levels = marker_levels)
  )

write.csv(comp_tbl, "QR_composition_bySource.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# =========================================================
# F) Permutation tests: global + pairwise (q1, q2)
# =========================================================
calc_div_by_source <- function(df_mat) {
  df_mat %>%
    group_by(Source) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(marker_levels), ~ mean(.x)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      s = sum(c_across(all_of(marker_levels))),
      p = list(if (s > 0) c_across(all_of(marker_levels)) / s else rep(0, length(marker_levels))),
      q1 = hill_numbers(unlist(p))["q1"],
      q2 = hill_numbers(unlist(p))["q2"]
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Source = factor(as.character(Source), levels = source_levels)) %>%
    arrange(Source) %>%
    select(Source, q1, q2)
}

global_stat <- function(v) max(v, na.rm = TRUE) - min(v, na.rm = TRUE)

perm_global_test <- function(df_mat, metric = c("q1", "q2"), nperm = 2000, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  metric <- match.arg(metric)

  obs <- calc_div_by_source(df_mat)
  obs_stat <- global_stat(obs[[metric]])

  perm_stats <- numeric(nperm)
  for (i in seq_len(nperm)) {
    dfp <- df_mat
    dfp$Source <- sample(dfp$Source)
    perm <- calc_div_by_source(dfp)
    perm_stats[i] <- global_stat(perm[[metric]])
  }

  tibble(metric = metric, obs_stat = obs_stat, p_value = mean(perm_stats >= obs_stat))
}

perm_pairwise <- function(df_mat, metric = c("q1", "q2"), nperm = 2000, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  metric <- match.arg(metric)

  pairs <- combn(source_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  res <- lapply(pairs, function(p) {
    a <- p[1]; b <- p[2]
    df2 <- df_mat %>% filter(as.character(Source) %in% c(a, b))

    obs <- calc_div_by_source(df2)
    obs_a <- obs %>% filter(as.character(Source) == a) %>% pull(!!sym(metric))
    obs_b <- obs %>% filter(as.character(Source) == b) %>% pull(!!sym(metric))
    obs_diff <- abs(obs_a - obs_b)

    perm_d <- numeric(nperm)
    for (i in seq_len(nperm)) {
      dfp <- df2
      dfp$Source <- sample(dfp$Source)
      perm <- calc_div_by_source(dfp)
      pa <- perm %>% filter(as.character(Source) == a) %>% pull(!!sym(metric))
      pb <- perm %>% filter(as.character(Source) == b) %>% pull(!!sym(metric))
      perm_d[i] <- abs(pa - pb)
    }

    tibble(metric = metric,
           group1 = a,
           group2 = b,
           obs_diff = obs_diff,
           p_value = mean(perm_d >= obs_diff))
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  res %>%
    mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    arrange(p_adj_BH)
}

N_PERM <- 2000
global_q1 <- perm_global_test(iso_mat, "q1", nperm = N_PERM, seed = 101)
global_q2 <- perm_global_test(iso_mat, "q2", nperm = N_PERM, seed = 102)
pair_q1   <- perm_pairwise(iso_mat, "q1", nperm = N_PERM, seed = 201)
pair_q2   <- perm_pairwise(iso_mat, "q2", nperm = N_PERM, seed = 202)

print(global_q1)
print(global_q2)
print(pair_q1, n = Inf)
print(pair_q2, n = Inf)

write.csv(global_q1, "QR_diversity_global_perm_q1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(global_q2, "QR_diversity_global_perm_q2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pair_q1,   "QR_diversity_pairwise_perm_q1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pair_q2,   "QR_diversity_pairwise_perm_q2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

#Strategizing for 3000-3500 Genome selection
## FINAL TARGETS 
# <2018: max 1400
# >=2018: 2100 total, with +100 added to HUMAN only:
#   +50 to 2018–2020 human, +50 to 2021–2025 human

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# BLOCK A (<2018)  = 1400 max (time + source balanced)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Rule A1: include ALL QR <2018 (fixed)
#   all_QR_pre2018 = 689  (your number)

# Rule A2: fill remainder with NON-QR to reach 1400, keeping source balance
# Pre-2018 totals (suggested):
#   Human   = 820 total (QR + NON-QR)
#   Chicken = 380 total
#   Other   = 200 total
# Total    = 1400
#
# Implementation rule:
#   - take ALL QR <2018 for each source (Human/Chicken/Other)
#   - then sample NON-QR within each source to hit its target total
#   - if a source cannot hit its target due to limited genomes, reallocate deficit:
#         first to Chicken (if deficit in Other), then Human; keep totals = 1400

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# BLOCK B (>=2018) = 2100 total (time-stratified + source-stratified)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Split >=2018 into two sections:
#   Section 1: 2018–2020  = 800 + 50 (human-only) = 850
#   Section 2: 2021–2025  = 1200 + 50 (human-only) = 1250
#
# Section 1 (2018–2020) totals:
#   Human   = 500   (450 + 50 added)
#   Chicken = 250
#   Other   = 100
#   Total   = 850
#
# Section 2 (2021–2025) totals:
#   Human   = 700   (650 + 50 added)
#   Chicken = 400
#   Other   = 150
#   Total   = 1250
#
# Within EACH (section × source):
#   target QR/NON-QR ≈ 70/30
#   - Human 2018–2020: 350 QR / 150 NON-QR
#   - Human 2021–2025: 490 QR / 210 NON-QR
#   - Chicken 2018–2020: 175 QR / 75 NON-QR
#   - Chicken 2021–2025: 280 QR / 120 NON-QR
#   - Other 2018–2020: 70 QR / 30 NON-QR
#   - Other 2021–2025: 105 QR / 45 NON-QR
#
# Marker representation constraints (apply inside >=2018 blocks):
#   - Guarantee minimum representation IF PRESENT (otherwise take all available):
#       qnr*                >= 30 total
#       parC/parE mutations >= 25 total
#       oqxA/oqxB            >= 15 total
#       qepA                 >= 15 total
#       aac(6')-Ib-cr         >= 15 total
#
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# QUICK CHECK: totals
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# <2018: 1400
# >=2018: 850 + 1250 = 2100
# TOTAL: 3500

#For the "Outbreak" column, only one QR and non-QR must be selected in each outbreak/year if available, and "Location": must select representatives of all loaction present per year 

```{r}
## ============================================================
## FINAL 3500-GENOME SELECTION SCRIPT
## GUARANTEE: ALL NON-US INCLUDED
## ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)

## -----------------------------
## CONFIG
## -----------------------------
year_cut <- 2018
target_total <- 3500

A_total <- 1400

A_targets <- tibble(
  Source3 = c("Human","Chicken","Other"),
  target  = c(820, 380, 200)
)

B_sections <- tibble(
  section = c("2018-2020","2021-2025"),
  y_min   = c(2018, 2021),
  y_max   = c(2020, 2025),
  total   = c(850, 1250)
)

B_targets <- tibble(
  section = rep(B_sections$section, each = 3),
  Source3 = rep(c("Human","Chicken","Other"), times = 2),
  target  = c(500,250,100, 700,400,150)
) %>%
  mutate(
    target_QR  = round(target * 0.70),
    target_NQR = target - target_QR
  )

## -----------------------------
## HELPERS
## -----------------------------
clean_na <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA","N/A","none","null")] <- NA
  x
}

make_source3 <- function(x) {
  s <- tolower(x)
  case_when(
    str_detect(s,"human")   ~ "Human",
    str_detect(s,"chicken") ~ "Chicken",
    str_detect(s,"other")   ~ "Other",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

is_non_us <- function(x) {
  str_detect(tolower(x), "non-us|nonus|non_us")
}

assign_amr_pattern <- function(amr) {
  a <- tolower(ifelse(is.na(amr), "", amr))
  case_when(
    str_detect(a,"gyra[_-]?d87y") ~ "gyrA_d87Y",
    str_detect(a,"gyra[_-]?d87n") ~ "gyrA_d87N",
    str_detect(a,"gyra[_-]?s83y") ~ "gyrA_s83Y",
    str_detect(a,"gyra[_-]?d87g") ~ "gyrA_d87G",
    str_detect(a,"qnrb19")        ~ "qnrB19",
    TRUE                          ~ "others"
  )
}

safe_sample <- function(df, n) {
  if (n <= 0 || nrow(df) == 0) return(df[0,])
  slice_sample(df, n = min(n, nrow(df)))
}

## -----------------------------
## PREP DATA
## -----------------------------
SEN_work <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Year   = as.integer(Collection_year),
    Source_raw = Source,
    Source3 = make_source3(Source),
    NonUS  = is_non_us(Source),
    QR_group = if_else(QR_genotype == 1L, "QR","NON-QR"),
    Outbreak_clean = clean_na(Outbreak),
    Location_clean = clean_na(Location),
    AMR_pattern = assign_amr_pattern(`AMR genotypes`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year), Year >= 1990, Year <= 2025)

## ============================================================
## 🔒 FORCE-INCLUDE ALL NON-US
## ============================================================
forced_nonUS <- SEN_work %>% filter(NonUS)

SEN_work_remain <- SEN_work %>%
  anti_join(forced_nonUS, by = "row_id")

cat("Forced-in Non-US:", nrow(forced_nonUS), "\n")

## Adjust total targets
remaining_budget <- target_total - nrow(forced_nonUS)
if (remaining_budget <= 0) {
  stop("Non-US isolates exceed target_total — increase target_total")
}

## ============================================================
## BLOCK A (<2018)
## ============================================================
A_pool <- SEN_work_remain %>% filter(Year < year_cut)

A_QR <- A_pool %>% filter(QR_group=="QR")

A_plan <- A_targets %>%
  left_join(count(A_QR, Source3, name="nQR"), by="Source3") %>%
  mutate(
    nQR = replace_na(nQR,0),
    nNQ = pmax(target - nQR, 0)
  )

A_NQR <- A_plan %>%
  mutate(pick = map2(Source3, nNQ, ~{
    A_pool %>% filter(Source3==.x, QR_group=="NON-QR") %>% safe_sample(.y)
  })) %>%
  select(pick) %>% unnest(cols = pick)

A_sel <- bind_rows(A_QR, A_NQR) %>% distinct(row_id,.keep_all=TRUE)

if (nrow(A_sel) < A_total) {
  rem <- A_pool %>% anti_join(A_sel, by="row_id")
  A_sel <- bind_rows(A_sel, safe_sample(rem, A_total - nrow(A_sel)))
}

## ============================================================
## BLOCK B (>=2018)
## ============================================================
B_pool <- SEN_work_remain %>% filter(Year >= year_cut)

B_sel <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(B_targets)), function(i){

  sec <- B_targets$section[i]
  s3  <- B_targets$Source3[i]
  tQR <- B_targets$target_QR[i]
  tNQ <- B_targets$target_NQR[i]

  yrs <- B_sections %>% filter(section==sec)
  pool <- B_pool %>%
    filter(Year >= yrs$y_min, Year <= yrs$y_max, Source3==s3)

  picked <- pool[0,]

  fill_group <- function(qr_label, need_n) {
    rem <- pool %>% anti_join(picked, by="row_id") %>% filter(QR_group==qr_label)
    if (need_n <= 0 || nrow(rem)==0) return(rem[0,])

    map_dfr(unique(rem$Year), function(y){
      py <- rem %>% filter(Year==y)
      if (nrow(py)==0) return(py)

      props <- py %>% count(AMR_pattern) %>% mutate(w=n/sum(n))
      alloc <- props %>% mutate(n_take=round(w*need_n))
      py %>% left_join(alloc, by="AMR_pattern") %>%
        group_by(AMR_pattern) %>%
        group_modify(~ safe_sample(.x, unique(.x$n_take))) %>%
        ungroup()
    })
  }

  picked <- bind_rows(
    fill_group("QR", tQR),
    fill_group("NON-QR", tNQ)
  ) %>% distinct(row_id,.keep_all=TRUE)

  picked %>% slice_head(n=tQR+tNQ) %>% mutate(section=sec)
})

## ============================================================
## FINAL MERGE
## ============================================================
sel_all <- bind_rows(
  forced_nonUS,
  A_sel %>% mutate(section="<2018"),
  B_sel
) %>% distinct(row_id,.keep_all=TRUE)

if (nrow(sel_all) > target_total) {
  keep_nonUS <- sel_all %>% filter(NonUS)
  rest <- sel_all %>% filter(!NonUS)
  sel_all <- bind_rows(
    keep_nonUS,
    safe_sample(rest, target_total - nrow(keep_nonUS))
  )
}

cat("FINAL N =", nrow(sel_all), "\n")

write.csv(sel_all, "Selected_3500_genomes.csv", row.names=FALSE)

```

```{r}
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)

# ============================================================
# 5. QR/FQR MARKER NORMALIZATION
#
# Same logic used in previous QR/FQR visualization.
# ============================================================

pretty_token <- function(x) {

  x <- str_trim(x)

  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    "\\s+",
    ""
  )

  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    "-",
    "_"
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # QRDR genes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^gyra_", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "gyrA_"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^gyrb_", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "gyrB_"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^parc_", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "parC_"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^pare_", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "parE_"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^pard_", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "parD_"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^grla_", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "grlA_"
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Plasmid-mediated quinolone resistance genes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^qnras", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "qnrAS"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^qnra", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "qnrA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^qnrb", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "qnrB"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^qnrc", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "qnrC"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^qnrd", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "qnrD"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^qnre", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "qnrE"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^qnrs", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "qnrS"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^qnrvc", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "qnrVC"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^qepa", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "qepA"
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Other relevant quinolone-associated genes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^nfxb", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "nfxB"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^emrr", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "emrR"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^norm", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "norM"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^pmra", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "pmrA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^acrb", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "acrB"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^acra", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "acrA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^tolc", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "tolC"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^crpp", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "crpP"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^oqxa", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "oqxA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^oqxb", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "oqxB"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^rama", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "ramA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^ramr", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "ramR"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^mara", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "marA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^marr", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "marR"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^soxr", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "soxR"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex("^soxs", ignore_case = TRUE),
    "soxS"
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # AAC(6')-Ib-cr
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^aac\\(?6'?\\)?[_-]?ib[_-]?cr",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "aac(6')-Ib-cr"
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Uppercase amino-acid substitution suffix
  #
  # Example:
  # gyrA_d87y -> gyrA_D87Y
  # gyrA_s83y -> gyrA_S83Y
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  has_suffix <- str_detect(
    x,
    "_"
  )

  ifelse(
    has_suffix,
    paste0(
      str_extract(x, "^[^_]+"),
      "_",
      toupper(
        str_extract(
          x,
          "(?<=_).+$"
        )
      )
    ),
    x
  )

}


# ============================================================
# 6. QR/FQR REGEX
# ============================================================

qr_regex <- regex(
  paste0(
    "^(",
    "gyrA|",
    "gyrB|",
    "parC|",
    "parE|",
    "parD|",
    "grlA|",
    "qnrAS|",
    "qnrA|",
    "qnrB|",
    "qnrC|",
    "qnrD|",
    "qnrE|",
    "qnrS|",
    "qnrVC|",
    "qepA|",
    "nfxB|",
    "emrR|",
    "norM|",
    "pmrA|",
    "acrB|",
    "acrA|",
    "tolC|",
    "crpP|",
    "oqxA|",
    "oqxB|",
    "ramA|",
    "ramR|",
    "marA|",
    "marR|",
    "soxR|",
    "soxS|",
    "aac\\(6'\\)-Ib-cr",
    ")"
  ),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)


# ============================================================
# 7. FUNCTION TO EXTRACT QR/FQR MARKERS
#
# IMPORTANT:
# Only QR_genotype == 1 genomes are used here.
#
# Each marker is counted once per genome.
# ============================================================

extract_qr_markers <- function(df) {

  df %>%
    filter(
      QR_genotype == 1L,
      !is.na(`AMR genotypes`)
    ) %>%

    select(
      row_id,
      Period,
      `AMR genotypes`
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      AMR_text = as.character(
        `AMR genotypes`
      )
    ) %>%

    # Extract entries such as:
    # gyrA_D87Y=...
    # qnrB19=...
    #
    # We capture the token immediately before "=".
    mutate(
      raw_tokens = str_extract_all(
        AMR_text,
        "[^,=\\s]+(?==)"
      )
    ) %>%

    select(
      -`AMR genotypes`,
      -AMR_text
    ) %>%

    unnest(
      cols = raw_tokens
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      marker = pretty_token(
        raw_tokens
      )
    ) %>%

    filter(
      !is.na(marker),
      str_detect(
        marker,
        qr_regex
      )
    ) %>%

    distinct(
      row_id,
      Period,
      marker
    )

}


# ============================================================
# 8. EXTRACT MARKERS FROM TOTAL AND SELECTED DATASETS
# ============================================================

SEN_qr_tokens <- extract_qr_markers(
  SEN_plot
)

SEL_qr_tokens <- extract_qr_markers(
  SEL_plot
)


# ============================================================
# 9. CALCULATE TOP 5 QR/FQR MARKERS FROM TOTAL POPULATION ONLY
# ============================================================

top5_table <- SEN_qr_tokens %>%
  count(
    marker,
    name = "n_genomes"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(n_genomes),
    marker
  ) %>%
  slice_head(
    n = 5
  )


top5_markers <- top5_table$marker


cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("TOP 5 QR/FQR MARKERS - TOTAL POPULATION\n")

# ============================================================
# 11. IMPORTANT QR/FQR VALIDATION
#
# Determine how many QR/FQR genomes have:
#   0 detected markers
#   1 detected marker
#   >1 detected marker
#
# User previously found ~99.5% of QR/FQR genomes carry
# a single QR/FQR marker.
# ============================================================

validate_marker_number <- function(df, tokens, label) {

  result <- df %>%
    filter(
      QR_genotype == 1L
    ) %>%
    select(
      row_id,
      Period
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      tokens %>%
        count(
          row_id,
          name = "n_markers"
        ),
      by = "row_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n_markers = replace_na(
        n_markers,
        0L
      ),

      marker_class = case_when(
        n_markers == 0 ~ "0 markers detected",
        n_markers == 1 ~ "1 marker",
        n_markers > 1 ~ ">1 marker"
      )
    )

  cat("\n============================================\n")
  cat(label, "- QR/FQR MARKER VALIDATION\n")
  cat("============================================\n")

  result %>%
    count(
      marker_class,
      name = "N"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Percent = round(
        100 * N / sum(N),
        3
      )
    ) %>%
    print(n = Inf)

  result
}

SEL_marker_validation <- validate_marker_number(

# ============================================================
# 12. BUILD STACKED PLOT DATA
#
# STACK:
#   QS/FQS
#   Top 5 markers
#   others
#
# QS/FQS is derived directly from QR_genotype == 0.
#
# QR/FQR genomes are represented by their marker.
#
# For QR/FQR genomes:
#   - Top 5 marker -> corresponding marker category
#   - any other QR marker -> "others"
#   - no parsed QR marker -> "others"
#
# This ensures every QR/FQR genome remains represented.
# ============================================================

build_plot_data <- function(df, tokens) {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # QS/FQS genomes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  qs <- df %>%
    filter(
      QR_genotype == 0L
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      row_id,
      Period,
      Category = "QS/FQS"
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # QR/FQR genomes with parsed markers
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  qr_with_marker <- df %>%
    filter(
      QR_genotype == 1L
    ) %>%
    select(
      row_id,
      Period
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      tokens,
      by = c(
        "row_id",
        "Period"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Category = case_when(
        marker %in% top5_markers ~ marker,
        TRUE ~ "others"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      row_id,
      Period,
      Category
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Combine
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  bind_rows(
    qs,
    qr_with_marker
  )

}

SEL_stack_long <- build_plot_data(
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# =========================================================
# INPUTS (selected genomes only)
# =========================================================
# If you already have your selected set in memory, set:
#   SEL <- sel_all
# Otherwise read from the file you wrote:
SEL <- read.csv("Selected_3500_genomes.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# =========================================================
# CONFIG
# =========================================================
amr_col    <- "AMR genotypes"
year_col   <- "Collection_year"
source_col <- "Source"
qr_col     <- "QR_genotype"

source_levels <- c("Human", "Chicken-US", "Chicken-Non-US", "Other-US", "Other-Non-US")

# Major QR markers (from your chart y-axis)
major_markers <- c("gyra_d87y", "gyra_d87n", "gyra_s83y", "gyra_d87g", "qnrb19")
marker_levels <- c(major_markers, "other_qr", "non_qr")  # add NON-QR to the stack

# =========================================================
# HELPERS
# =========================================================
clean_txt <- function(x){
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", x)
  str_to_lower(str_squish(x))
}

extract_tokens <- function(amr_txt){
  amr_txt <- clean_txt(amr_txt)
  toks <- str_extract_all(amr_txt, "[^,=\\s]+(?==)")[[1]]
  toks <- str_to_lower(str_replace_all(str_trim(toks), "\\s+", ""))
  toks[toks != ""]
}

# classify each row into ONE bucket:
#  - NON-QR -> "non_qr"
#  - QR -> top gyrA markers first, then qnrb19, else "other_qr"
row_bucket <- function(tokens, is_qr){
  if (is.na(is_qr) || is_qr != 1L) return("non_qr")
  if (length(tokens) == 0) return("other_qr")

  toks <- str_to_lower(tokens)
  toks <- str_replace_all(toks, "^gyra_", "gyra_")
  toks <- str_replace_all(toks, "^gyrA_", "gyra_")
  toks <- str_replace_all(toks, "^gyra", "gyra")
  toks <- str_replace_all(toks, "^qnrb19$", "qnrb19")

  # priority: gyrA major markers first
  for (m in major_markers[grepl("^gyra_", major_markers)]) {
    if (any(toks == m)) return(m)
  }
  # then qnrb19
  if (any(toks %in% c("qnrb19","qnr_b19","qnr-b19","qnrb_19","qnrB19"))) return("qnrb19")

  "other_qr"
}

make_year3 <- function(y){
  y <- as.integer(y)
  start <- y - ((y - min(y, na.rm = TRUE)) %% 3)
  paste0(start, "-", start + 2)
}

# =========================================================
# BUILD STACKED COUNTS (SELECTED ONLY) + NON-QR INCLUDED
# =========================================================
df_plot <- SEL %>%
  mutate(
    Year   = as.integer(.data[[year_col]]),
    Source = as.character(.data[[source_col]]),
    Source = factor(Source, levels = source_levels),
    is_qr  = as.integer(.data[[qr_col]]),
    amr_txt = .data[[amr_col]]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year), Year >= 1990, Year <= 2025, !is.na(Source)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    tokens = list(extract_tokens(amr_txt)),
    bucket = row_bucket(tokens, is_qr)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    year3  = make_year3(Year),
    bucket = factor(bucket, levels = marker_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(Source, year3, bucket, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(Source) %>%
  complete(year3, bucket, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

# order x-axis chronologically
year3_levels <- df_plot %>%
  distinct(year3) %>%
  mutate(start = as.integer(str_extract(year3, "^\\d{4}"))) %>%
  arrange(start) %>%
  pull(year3)

df_plot <- df_plot %>%
  mutate(year3 = factor(year3, levels = year3_levels))

# =========================================================
# PLOT
# =========================================================
p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = year3, y = n, fill = bucket)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~ Source, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Collection year (3-year groups)",
    y = "Selected genomes (count)",
    fill = "QR bucket"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text   = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p)

# Optional save
# ggsave("SelectedGenomes_majorQR_plus_nonQR_3yr_by_source.png", p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 600)


```

#selection description
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

# =========================================================
# 1) FORCE RELOAD OF FINAL 3434-GENOME DATASET
# =========================================================

rm(SEL)

SEL <- read_csv(
  "Finalupdated_SEN_Genomes1.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# =========================================================
# 2) VERIFY CORRECT FILE
# =========================================================

cat("Rows =", nrow(SEL), "\n")

cat(
  "QR columns found:\n"
)

print(
  grep(
    "QR",
    names(SEL),
    value = TRUE
  )
)

# This MUST pass
stopifnot(nrow(SEL) == 3434)
stopifnot("QR_genotype" %in% names(SEL))


# =========================================================
# 3) CREATE METHODS VARIABLES
# =========================================================

SEL_methods <- SEL %>%
  mutate(
    Collection_year = as.integer(
      .data[["Collection_year"]]
    ),

    International =
      .data[["Source"]] == "International",

    QR_status = if_else(
      as.integer(.data[["QR_genotype"]]) == 1L,
      "QR/FQR",
      "FQS"
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 4) INTERNATIONAL
# =========================================================

n_international <- SEL_methods %>%
  filter(International) %>%
  nrow()


# =========================================================
# 5) TEMPORAL DATA
#    EXCLUDE INTERNATIONAL SO THEY ARE NOT DOUBLE-COUNTED
# =========================================================

temporal <- SEL_methods %>%
  filter(
    !International,
    !is.na(Collection_year)
  )


# =========================================================
# 6) METHODS COUNTS
# =========================================================

methods_counts <- temporal %>%
  mutate(
    Period = if_else(
      Collection_year < 2018,
      "Pre-2018",
      "2018-2025"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(
    Period,
    QR_status,
    name = "n"
  )

print(methods_counts)


# =========================================================
# 7) EXTRACT NUMBERS
# =========================================================

pre_fqr <- temporal %>%
  filter(
    Collection_year < 2018,
    QR_status == "QR/FQR"
  ) %>%
  nrow()

pre_fqs <- temporal %>%
  filter(
    Collection_year < 2018,
    QR_status == "FQS"
  ) %>%
  nrow()

post_fqr <- temporal %>%
  filter(
    Collection_year >= 2018,
    Collection_year <= 2025,
    QR_status == "QR/FQR"
  ) %>%
  nrow()

post_fqs <- temporal %>%
  filter(
    Collection_year >= 2018,
    Collection_year <= 2025,
    QR_status == "FQS"
  ) %>%
  nrow()


# =========================================================
# 8) 2018-2020 / 2021-2025 BREAKDOWN
# =========================================================

later_breakdown <- temporal %>%
  filter(
    Collection_year >= 2018,
    Collection_year <= 2025
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Period = case_when(
      Collection_year <= 2020 ~ "2018-2020",
      Collection_year >= 2021 ~ "2021-2025"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(
    Period,
    QR_status,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Period) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(n),
    Percent = round(100 * n / Total, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

print(later_breakdown)


# =========================================================
# 9) FINAL TOTAL
# =========================================================

final_total <-
  n_international +
  pre_fqr +
  pre_fqs +
  post_fqr +
  post_fqs

cat(
  "\n============================\n",
  "International     =", n_international, "\n",
  "Pre-2018 QR/FQR   =", pre_fqr, "\n",
  "Pre-2018 FQS      =", pre_fqs, "\n",
  "2018-2025 QR/FQR  =", post_fqr, "\n",
  "2018-2025 FQS     =", post_fqs, "\n",
  "TOTAL             =", final_total, "\n",
  "============================\n"
)

stopifnot(final_total == 3434)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SELECTED 3434-GENOME SEN QR/FQR ANALYSIS
# =========================================================
#
# INPUT:

#   row_id

#   AMR genotypes
#
# FOUR FIGURES:
#
#   1. QS/FQS vs QR/FQR — PERCENT
#   2. QS/FQS vs QR/FQR — COUNT
#   3. QS/FQS + TOP 5 QR/FQR markers + others — PERCENT
#   4. QS/FQS + TOP 5 QR/FQR markers + others — COUNT
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   - Collection_year is used directly.
#   - Source is used directly.
#   - Existing row_id is preserved.
#   - QR_genotype defines binary QR/FQR status.
#   - AMR genotypes defines individual QR/FQR markers.
#   - QS/FQS is placed at TOP of stacked bars.
#   - Years with no genomes retain an x-axis position but no bar.
#
# =========================================================


library(dplyr)

# =========================================================
# 6) YEAR LEVELS

year_levels <- c(
  "≤2000",
  as.character(
    2001:2025
  )
)


# =========================================================
# 7) INTEGER-ONLY Y-AXIS BREAKS
# =========================================================

integer_breaks <- function(x) {

  b <- pretty(
    x,
    n = 5
  )

  b <- b[
    b >= 0 &
      b >= x[1] &
      b <= x[2] &
      abs(
        b - round(b)
      ) < 1e-8
  ]

  unique(
    as.integer(
      round(b)
    )
  )
}


# =========================================================
# 8) PRETTY QR/FQR TOKEN FUNCTION
# =========================================================

pretty_token <- function(x) {

  x <- str_trim(x)

  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    "\\s+",
    ""
  )

  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    "-",
    "_"
  )


  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Chromosomal QR targets
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^gyra",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "gyrA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^gyrb",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "gyrB"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^parc",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "parC"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^pard",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "parD"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^pare",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "parE"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^grla",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "grlA"
  )


  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # qnr family
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^qnras",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "qnrAS"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^qnra",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "qnrA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^qnrb",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "qnrB"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^qnrc",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "qnrC"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^qnrd",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "qnrD"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^qnre",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "qnrE"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^qnrs",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "qnrS"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^qnrvc",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "qnrVC"
  )


  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Other QR/FQR-associated families
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^qepa",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "qepA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^nfxb",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "nfxB"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^emrr",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "emrR"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^norm",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "norM"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^pmra",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "pmrA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^acrb",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "acrB"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^smef",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "smeF"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^acra",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "acrA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^tolc",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "tolC"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^crpp",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "crpP"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^oqxa",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "oqxA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^oqxb",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "oqxB"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^rama",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "ramA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^ramr",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "ramR"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^mara",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "marA"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^marr",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "marR"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^soxr",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "soxR"
  )

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^soxs",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "soxS"
  )


  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # AAC(6')-Ib-cr
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  x <- str_replace(
    x,
    regex(
      "^aac\\(6'?\\)_?ib_?cr",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    ),
    "aac(6')_Ib_cr"
  )


  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Uppercase mutation / allele suffix after underscore
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  x <- if_else(

    str_detect(
      x,
      "_"
    ),

    paste0(

      str_extract(
        x,
        "^[^_]+"
      ),

      "_",

      str_to_upper(
        str_remove(
          x,
          "^[^_]+_"
        )
      )
    ),

    x
  )

  x
}


# =========================================================
# 9) QR/FQR REGEX
# =========================================================

qr_regex <- regex(

  paste0(

    "^(",

    "gyrA|gyrB|",
    "parC|parD|parE|",
    "grlA|",

    "qnrAS|qnrA|qnrB|qnrC|qnrD|qnrE|qnrS|qnrVC|",

    "qep[A-Za-z0-9]*|",

    "nfxB|emrR|norM|pmrA|",

    "acrA|acrB|tolC|",

    "smeF|",

    "crpP|",

    "oqxA|oqxB|",

    "ramA|ramR|",

    "marA|marR|",

    "soxR|soxS|",

    "aac\\(6'\\)_Ib_cr",

    ")",

    "(_.*)?$"
  ),

  ignore_case = TRUE
)


# =========================================================
# 10) PREPARE SELECTED DATASET
#
# IMPORTANT:
#
# Existing:
#   row_id
#   Source
#   Collection_year
#
# are used directly.
#
# Nothing is reconstructed.
# =========================================================

SEL_plot <- SEL %>%

  mutate(

    Collection_year =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          Collection_year
        )
      ),

    QR_binary =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          QR_genotype
        )
      ),

    QR_status = case_when(

      QR_binary == 1L ~
        "QR/FQR",

      QR_binary == 0L ~
        "QS/FQS",

      TRUE ~
        NA_character_
    ),

    year_plot = case_when(

      is.na(Collection_year) ~
        NA_character_,

      Collection_year <= 2000 ~
        "≤2000",

      TRUE ~
        as.character(
          Collection_year
        )
    )
  ) %>%

  filter(

    !is.na(
      Collection_year
    ),

    Collection_year >= 1990,

    Collection_year <= 2025,

    !is.na(
      Source
    ),

    Source != "",

    !is.na(
      QR_status
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    year_plot = factor(
      year_plot,
      levels = year_levels
    ),

    QR_status = factor(
      QR_status,
      levels = c(
        "QS/FQS",
        "QR/FQR"
      )
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 11) VERIFY 2024 AND 2025 AFTER PREPARATION
# =========================================================

cat(
  "\n========================================\n",
  "POST-PREPARATION 2024-2025 CHECK\n",
  "========================================\n"
)

post_recent_check <- SEL_plot %>%

  filter(
    Collection_year %in%
      c(
        2024,
        2025
      )
  ) %>%

  count(
    Source,
    Collection_year,
    QR_status,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%

  arrange(

    Collection_year,

  )

)

  "========================================\n"
)

print(

# =========================================================
# 13) TEMPORAL DATASET SIZE
# =========================================================

cat(
  "\n========================================\n",
  "TEMPORAL DATASET SIZE\n",
  "========================================\n"
)

cat(

# =========================================================
# PART A
#

# =========================================================
# 15) BINARY COUNTS

sel_binary_stack <- SEL_plot %>%

  count(

      )
    )

# 16) TRUE YEAR TOTALS

sel_binary_totals <- SEL_plot %>%

  count(

  ) %>%

  left_join(
    sel_src_N %>%

        Source,

      ),

  ) %>%

      levels = year_levels
    )

# =========================================================
# 17) BINARY STACK VALIDATION
# =========================================================

binary_validation <- sel_binary_stack %>%

  group_by(
    Source,
    year_plot
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    n_stack = sum(
      n

    pct_stack = sum(

  )

# =========================================================

#
# IMPORTANT:

      )
    },

      mult = c(

        0
      )
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(

  ) +

    x =

    fill =

  ) +

      ),

      ),

      ),

    strip.background =

      ),

  )


# =========================================================
# 19) BINARY COUNT PLOT
# =========================================================

p_sel_binary_count <- ggplot(

        hjust = 1,
        size = 7
      ),

    axis.text.y =
      element_text(
        size = 7
      ),

    axis.title =
      element_text(
        size = 8
      ),

    strip.text =
      element_text(
        size = 8
      ),

    legend.title =
      element_text(
        size = 8
      ),

    legend.text =
      element_text(
        size = 8
      ),

    panel.spacing =
      unit(
        0.50,
        "lines"
      ),

    strip.background =
      element_rect(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.4
      ),

    strip.placement =
      "outside"
  )


# =========================================================
# PART B
#
# INDIVIDUAL QR/FQR MARKER ANALYSIS
# =========================================================


# =========================================================
# 20) TOKENIZE AMR GENOTYPES
#
# IMPORTANT:
#
# Existing row_id is carried through directly.
# =========================================================

sel_tok_long <- SEL_plot %>%

  select(

    row_id,

    Source,

    Collection_year,

    year_plot,

    QR_status,

    `AMR genotypes`
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    token_raw = str_extract_all(

      coalesce(
        `AMR genotypes`,
        ""
      ),

      "[^,=\\s]+(?==)"
    )
  ) %>%

  unnest_longer(
    token_raw
  ) %>%

  filter(

    !is.na(
      token_raw
    ),

    token_raw != ""
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    token_norm =
      pretty_token(
        token_raw
      )
  )


# =========================================================
# 21) RETAIN QR/FQR TOKENS
# =========================================================

sel_tok_qr <- sel_tok_long %>%

  filter(

    str_detect(
      token_norm,
      qr_regex
    )
  ) %>%

  distinct(

    row_id,

    Source,

    Collection_year,

    year_plot,

    QR_status,

    token_norm
  )


# =========================================================
# 22) PRINT ALL QR/FQR MARKERS
# =========================================================

sel_marker_counts <- sel_tok_qr %>%

  distinct(
    row_id,
    token_norm
  ) %>%

  count(
    token_norm,
    name = "n_genomes",
    sort = TRUE
  )


cat(
  "\n========================================\n",
  "ALL QR/FQR MARKERS IN SELECTED DATASET\n",
  "========================================\n"
)

print(
  sel_marker_counts,
  n = Inf
)


# =========================================================
# 23) VALIDATE QR_genotype AGAINST MARKER EXTRACTION
# =========================================================

sel_marker_presence <- sel_tok_qr %>%

  distinct(
    row_id
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    marker_detected =
      TRUE
  )


sel_qr_validation <- SEL_plot %>%

  select(
    row_id,
    Source,
    Collection_year,
    QR_status
  ) %>%

  left_join(
    sel_marker_presence,
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    marker_detected =
      replace_na(
        marker_detected,
        FALSE
      )
  )


cat(
  "\n========================================\n",
  "QR_genotype vs EXTRACTED QR/FQR MARKER\n",
  "========================================\n"
)

print(

  table(

    sel_qr_validation$QR_status,

    sel_qr_validation$marker_detected,

    useNA =
      "ifany"
  )
)


# =========================================================
# 24) TOP 5 QR/FQR MARKERS
#
# Calculated from the selected population itself.
# =========================================================

sel_top5 <- sel_marker_counts %>%

  slice_head(
    n = 5
  ) %>%

  pull(
    token_norm
  )


cat(
  "\n========================================\n",
  "TOP 5 QR/FQR MARKERS\n",
  "========================================\n"
)

print(
  sel_top5
)


# =========================================================
# 25) ASSIGN TOP 5 / OTHERS
# =========================================================

sel_marker_long <- sel_tok_qr %>%

  mutate(

    marker_group =
      if_else(

        token_norm %in%
          sel_top5,

        token_norm,

        "others"
      )
  ) %>%

  distinct(

    row_id,

    Source,

    Collection_year,

    year_plot,

    marker_group
  )


# =========================================================
# 26) MARKER MULTIPLICITY
# =========================================================

sel_marker_multiplicity <- sel_marker_long %>%

  count(
    row_id,
    name = "n_marker_groups"
  ) %>%

  count(
    n_marker_groups,
    name = "n_genomes"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    pct =
      100 *
      n_genomes /
      sum(
        n_genomes
      )
  )


cat(
  "\n========================================\n",
  "QR/FQR MARKER MULTIPLICITY\n",
  "========================================\n"
)

print(
  sel_marker_multiplicity,
  n = Inf
)


# =========================================================
# 27) ALL GENOMES / TRUE DENOMINATOR
#
# This is the denominator for expanded percentage plots.
# =========================================================

sel_all_genomes_year <- SEL_plot %>%

  select(

    row_id,

    Source,

    Collection_year,

    year_plot,

    QR_status
  )


# =========================================================
# 28) TRUE SOURCE × YEAR TOTALS
# =========================================================

sel_true_year_totals <- sel_all_genomes_year %>%

  count(

    Source,

    year_plot,

    name =
      "N_year"
  )


# =========================================================
# 29) QS/FQS ROWS
#
# QR_genotype == 0 is authoritative.
# =========================================================

sel_susceptible_rows <- sel_all_genomes_year %>%

  filter(
    QR_status ==
      "QS/FQS"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    marker_group =
      "QS/FQS"
  ) %>%

  select(

    row_id,

    Source,

    Collection_year,

    year_plot,

    marker_group
  )


# =========================================================
# 30) QR/FQR MARKER ROWS
#
# Only genomes with QR_genotype == 1 are included
# on the QR/FQR side of the expanded chart.
# =========================================================

sel_qr_marker_rows <- sel_all_genomes_year %>%

  filter(
    QR_status ==
      "QR/FQR"
  ) %>%

  select(

    row_id,

    Source,

    Collection_year,

    year_plot
  ) %>%

  inner_join(

    sel_marker_long %>%
      select(
        row_id,
        marker_group
      ),

    by =
      "row_id"
  )


# =========================================================
# 31) QR/FQR GENOMES WITHOUT EXTRACTED MARKER
# =========================================================

sel_qr_without_marker <- sel_all_genomes_year %>%

  filter(
    QR_status ==
      "QR/FQR"
  ) %>%

  anti_join(

    sel_marker_long %>%
      distinct(
        row_id
      ),

    by =
      "row_id"
  )


cat(
  "\n========================================\n",
  "QR/FQR GENOMES WITHOUT EXTRACTED MARKER\n",
  "========================================\n"
)

cat(
  "N =",
  nrow(
    sel_qr_without_marker
  ),
  "\n"
)


if (
  nrow(
    sel_qr_without_marker
  ) > 0
) {

  print(
    sel_qr_without_marker,
    n = Inf
  )
}


# =========================================================
# 32) COMBINE QS/FQS + QR/FQR MARKERS
# =========================================================

sel_expanded_genome_marker <- bind_rows(

  sel_susceptible_rows,

  sel_qr_marker_rows
)


# =========================================================
# 33) EXPANDED CATEGORY ORDER
#
# QS/FQS FIRST.
#
# With normal ggplot stacking this puts QS/FQS
# at the TOP.
# =========================================================

sel_expanded_marker_levels <- c(

  "QS/FQS",

  sel_top5,

  "others"
)


sel_expanded_genome_marker <-
  sel_expanded_genome_marker %>%

  mutate(

    marker_group =
      factor(
        marker_group,
        levels =
          sel_expanded_marker_levels
      ),

    year_plot =
      factor(
        year_plot,
        levels =
          year_levels
      )
  )


# =========================================================
# 34) COUNT EXPANDED CATEGORIES
# =========================================================

sel_expanded_stack <- sel_expanded_genome_marker %>%

  ) %>%

    sel_true_year_totals,

    by =

        "Source",
        "year_plot"
      )
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    pct =
      100 *
      n /
      N_year
  ) %>%

  left_join(

    sel_src_N %>%
      select(
        Source,
        Source_lab
      ),

    by =
      "Source"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    year_plot =
      factor(
        year_plot,
        levels =
          year_levels
      ),

    marker_group =
      factor(
        marker_group,
        levels =
          sel_expanded_marker_levels
      )
  )


# =========================================================
# 35) TRUE TOTALS FOR EXPANDED COUNT LABELS
# =========================================================

sel_expanded_totals <- sel_true_year_totals %>%

  left_join(

    sel_src_N %>%

      ),

      "Source"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    year_plot =
      factor(
        year_plot,
        levels =
          year_levels
      )
  )


# =========================================================
# 36) EXPANDED STACK VALIDATION
#
# If nearly all QR/FQR genomes have one marker,
# stacked_n should closely match N_year.
# =========================================================

sel_stack_check <- sel_expanded_stack %>%

  group_by(
    Source,
    year_plot
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    stacked_n =
      sum(
        n
      ),

    N_year =
      first(
        N_year
      ),

    stacked_pct =
      sum(
        pct
      ),

    difference_n =
      stacked_n -
      N_year,

    difference_pct =
      stacked_pct -
      100,

    .groups =
      "drop"
  )


cat(
  "\n========================================\n",
  "EXPANDED STACK VALIDATION\n",
  "========================================\n"
)

print(
  sel_stack_check,
  n = Inf
)


# =========================================================
# 37) COLORS

sel_n_qr_categories <-

sel_qr_colors <-
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)

set.seed(123)

## -----------------------------
## HELPERS (same as original)
## -----------------------------
clean_na <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "none", "null")] <- NA
  x
}

make_source3 <- function(x) {
  s <- tolower(x)
  case_when(
    str_detect(s, "human")   ~ "Human",
    str_detect(s, "chicken") ~ "Chicken",
    str_detect(s, "other")   ~ "Other",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

is_non_us <- function(x) {
  str_detect(tolower(x), "non-us|nonus|non_us")
}

assign_amr_pattern <- function(amr) {
  a <- tolower(ifelse(is.na(amr), "", amr))
  case_when(
    str_detect(a, "gyra[_-]?d87y") ~ "gyrA_d87Y",
    str_detect(a, "gyra[_-]?d87n") ~ "gyrA_d87N",
    str_detect(a, "gyra[_-]?s83y") ~ "gyrA_s83Y",
    str_detect(a, "gyra[_-]?d87g") ~ "gyrA_d87G",
    str_detect(a, "qnrb19")        ~ "qnrB19",
    TRUE                           ~ "others"
  )
}

## -----------------------------
## 1) BUILD SEN_work WITH ALL YOUR LOGIC
## -----------------------------
SEN_work <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    # keep original Strain / Isolate but trimmed for safer matching
    Strain  = str_squish(as.character(Strain)),
    Isolate = str_squish(as.character(Isolate)),

    row_id = row_number(),
    Year   = as.integer(Collection_year),
    Source_raw = Source,
    Source3 = make_source3(Source),
    NonUS  = is_non_us(Source),
    QR_group = if_else(QR_genotype == 1L, "QR", "NON-QR"),
    Outbreak_clean = clean_na(Outbreak),
    Location_clean = clean_na(Location),
    AMR_pattern = assign_amr_pattern(`AMR genotypes`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year), Year >= 1990, Year <= 2025)

## -----------------------------
## 2) READ KEY FILE (Strain, Isolate) AND TRIM
## -----------------------------
keys <- read_csv("Selected_updated_Isolate.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Strain  = str_squish(as.character(Strain)),
    Isolate = str_squish(as.character(Isolate))
  )

## -----------------------------
## 3) SUBSET SEN_work BY (Strain, Isolate)
## -----------------------------
SEN_final <- SEN_work %>%
  semi_join(keys, by = c("Strain", "Isolate"))

# How many matched?
nrow(SEN_final)

## -----------------------------
## 4) SAVE FULL SUBSET (ALL COLS FROM SEN_work)
```
